original: agṛhīteti| agṛhītavṛttikapuṣasyāgṛhītavṛttikapadādarthabodhādarśanādityarthaḥ| dharmāśe'pi śaktirastītyāha| na hīti| madhuratvamiti| madhuratvaprakārakabodhādarśanādityarthaḥ| taddharmāvacchinneti| ghaṭatvāvacchinnaviṣayakavṛttītyarthaḥ| jñāne vṛttivaiśiṣṭyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena | jñānādhirakaraṇatātvaṃ viṣayatayā|
analyzed: agṛhīta iti agṛhīta vṛttika puṣasya agṛhīta vṛttika padāt artha bodha adarśanāt iti arthaḥ dharma āśe pi śaktiḥ asti iti āha na hi iti madhura tvam iti madhura tva prakāraka bodha adarśanāt iti arthaḥ tad dharma avacchinna iti ghaṭa tva avacchinna viṣayaka vṛtti iti arthaḥ jñāne vṛtti vaiśiṣṭyam sāmānādhikaraṇyena viṣayatayā

original: tārkikā vṛttijñānapadajñānayoḥ pṛthak hetutvamicchanti| atra tu lāghavādviśiṣṭasyaiva hetutvamuktam| tatrāpi vṛttivaṣayakodbuddhasaṃskārasamānādhikaraṇavṛttyāśrayapadaviṣayakajñānasya hetutve gauravamataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyādīnāṃ sambandhakoṭau hetutve gauravamataḥ sāmānādhikaramyādīnāṃ sambandhakoṭau niveśaḥ|
analyzed: tārkikāḥ vṛtti jñāna pada jñānayoḥ pṛthak hetutvam icchanti atra tu lāghavāt viśiṣṭasya eva hetutvam uktam tatra api vṛtti vaṣayaka udbuddha saṃskāra samāna adhikaraṇa vṛtti āśraya pada viṣayaka jñānasya hetutve gauravam atas sāmānādhikaraṇya ādīnām sambandha koṭau hetutve gauravam atas sāmānādhikaramya ādīnām sambandha koṭau niveśaḥ

original: yasya hi ghaṭādipadasya vṛttirjñātā tatra pade vṛttiviṣayakasaṃskāro jñānaṃ cetyubhayamapi viṣatayāsti vṛttyāśrayapadaviṣayakaṃ ca tajjñānam| yattu vṛttyā padajanyapadārthepasthitiḥ śābdabodhe kāraṇaṃmiti tanna| tādṛśopasthititvasya gurutarasya kāraṇatāvacchekatvāpekṣayāsvajanyapadārthopasthitisambandhena padajñānasya hetutve lāghavāt|
analyzed: yasya hi ghaṭa ādi padasya vṛttiḥ jñātā tatra pade vṛtti viṣayaka saṃskāraḥ jñānam ca iti ubhayam api viṣatayā asti vṛtti āśraya pada viṣayakam ca tat jñānam yat tu vṛttyā pada janya padārtha upasthitiḥ śābdabodhe kāraṇam iti tat na tādṛśa upasthiti tvasya gurutarasya kāraṇa tā avaccheka tva apekṣayā asva janya padārtha upasthiti sambandhena pada jñānasya hetu tve lāghavāt

original: mānāntareti | madhuratvasyānumānādinopasthitirityarthaḥ| tārkikāstu jñānalakṣaṇājanyaṃ vadanti| ālaṅkārikāstvatra vyañjanāṃ vadanti| nanu madhuratvaprakārakaśaktigrahābhāvādruḍa ityekadeśaprayoge kathaṃ tādṛśabodha ityata āha| yatra tviti| na tviti| madhuratvavān guḍa ityanvayo netyarthaḥ| dhvanitamiti|
analyzed: māna antara iti madhura tvasya anumāna ādinā upasthitiḥ iti arthaḥ tārkikāḥ tu jñāna lakṣaṇa ajanyam vadanti ālaṅkārikāḥ tu atra vyañjanām vadanti nanu madhura tva prakāraka śaktigraha abhāvāt ruḍaḥ iti eka deśa prayoge katham tādṛśa bodhaḥ iti atas āha yatra tu iti na tu iti madhura tvavān guḍaḥ iti anvayaḥ na iti arthaḥ dhvanitam iti

original: tatra hi dadhyodana ityatra dadhiśabdenaiva dadhyupasiktapratītiḥ guḍa ityatra madhuratvasya prakārāntareṇa pratītāvapi na tasya śābdavācyateti spaṣṭam|
analyzed: tatra hi dadhi odanaḥ iti atra dadhi śabdena eva dadhi upasikta pratītiḥ guḍaḥ iti atra madhura tvasya prakāra antareṇa pratītau api na tasya śābda vācya tā iti spaṣṭam

original: atha guḍaṃ bhuṅkte ityatra guḍatvasyeva madhuratvasyāpi prakāratayā tatprakārakaśābdabodhavāraṇāya guḍatvaprakārakaguḍaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhaṃ pratitādṛśasaktijñānapattiḥ, tatrākāśatvasya śabdāśrayatvasya śabdāśrayatvarūpatayāvacchekatāyā niravacchinnatvāditi cenna| ākāśapadānnirvikalpakopasthitereva svīkāreṇa tatredṛśahetutvākalpanāt|
analyzed: atha guḍam bhuṅkte iti atra guḍa tvasya iva madhura tvasya api prakāratayā tad prakāraka śābdabodha vāraṇāya guḍa tva prakāraka guḍa viśeṣyaka śābdabodham prati tādṛśa sakti jñāna pattiḥ tatra ākāśa tvasya śabda āśraya tvasya śabda āśraya tva rūpa tayā avaccheka tāyāḥ niravacchinna tvāt iti ced na ākāśa padāt nirvikalpaka upasthiteḥ eva svīkāreṇa tatra īdṛśa hetutva akalpanāt

original: ākāśatvasyāpi jātitvācca| etena nirvikalpakasvīkāre ākāśaṃ dravyamityatra bhinnaprakārakopasthityabhāvādabhedabodhānāpattiriti parāstam| yadapi ākāśasyaikavyaktitvenānugamakadharmānapekṣaṇe'pi niyatopasthitaye śabdāśrayatvamākāśapadaśaktimiti tanna| śābdikamate ākāśatvādarepi jātitvāt|
analyzed: ākāśa tvasya api jāti tvāt ca etena nirvikalpaka svīkāre ākāśam dravyam iti atra bhinna prakāraka upasthiti abhāvāt abheda bodha anāpattiḥ iti parāstam yat api ākāśasya eka vyakti tvena anugamaka dharma anapekṣaṇe api niyata upasthitaye śabda āśraya tvam ākāśa pada śaktim iti tat na śābdika mate ākāśa tva ādare api jāti tvāt

original: nanu ghaṭaghaṭatve ityādinirvikalpakasya ghaṭatvādiprakārakatvābhāvātkathaṃ ghaṭādipadārthajñānajanyatvamiti cenna| nirvikalpakasyātīndriyatayā tasya kāryatāvaccedakatvānabhyupagamāt|| 1.5 ||
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa ghaṭa tve ityādi nirvikalpakasya ghaṭa tva ādi prakāraka tva abhāvāt katham ghaṭa ādi padārtha jñāna janya tvam iti ced na nirvikalpakasya atīndriya tayā tasya kārya tāvat cedaka tva anabhyupagamāt

original: vyattyāseneti| ghaṭatvaviśepyakaśaktigrahānantaraṃ ghaṭatvaprakārakaśābdabodhavāraṇāyetyarthaḥ| taddharmāvacchinnetīti| nanvevaṃ tadādīnāṃ buddhisthatvāvacchinne śaktigrahāt tamānayetyukte buddhisthamānayetyeva bodhaḥ syānna tu ghaṭatvādiviśeṣarūpeṇa|
analyzed: vyatti āsena iti ghaṭa tva viśepyaka śakti graha anantaram ghaṭa tva prakāraka śābdabodha vāraṇāya iti arthaḥ tad dharma avacchinna iti iti nanu evam tad ādīnām buddhi stha tva avacchinne śakti grahāt tam ānaya iti ukte buddhi stham ānaya iti eva bodhaḥ syāt na tu ghaṭa tva ādi viśeṣa rūpeṇa

original: ata eva vanhivyāpyadhūvatparvataṃ tacchabdena parāmṛśya sa vahnimāniti vākyajanyaśābdabodhe parāmarśajanyatvenānumitilakṣaṇātivyāptiruktā dīdhitāviti cedatrāhuḥ| sānānyarūpeṇa śaktāvapi tyadādito viśeṣarūpeṇaivopasthitiḥ| upasthitiśaktigrahayoḥ samānākākakatvapravādastu tyadādyatiriktaviṣaya iti ghaṭatvādiviśeṣa eva śakyatāvacchekaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva vanhi vyāpya dhūvat parvatam tad śabdena parāmṛśya sa vahnimān iti vākya janya śābda bodhe parāmarśa janya tvena anumiti lakṣaṇa ativyāptiḥ uktā dīdhitau iti ced atra āhuḥ sā na anya rūpeṇa śaktau api tyad āditaḥ viśeṣa rūpeṇa eva upasthitiḥ upasthiti śakti grahayoḥ tu tyad ādi atirikta viṣayaḥ iti ghaṭa tva ādi viśeṣaḥ eva śakyatā avacchekaḥ

original: tadādīnāṃ nānārthatvamiṣṭamevetyanye | svaviṣayaketi| vṛttiviṣayako ya ud‌buddhasaṃskāraḥ tatsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vṛttyāśrayapadaviṣayakatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| asti ca ghaṭapadārthanirūpitavṛttiviṣayakaḥ ud‌buddhasaṃskāraḥ viṣayatayā ghaṭadajñānaṃ ca |apambhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tad ādīnām nānārthatvam iṣṭam eva iti anye sva viṣayaka iti vṛtti viṣayakaḥ yaḥ udbuddha saṃskāraḥ tad sāmānādhikaraṇyam vṛtti āśraya pada viṣayaka tvam ca iti arthaḥ asti ca ghaṭa padārtha nirūpita vṛtti viṣayakaḥ udbuddha saṃskāraḥ viṣayatayā ghaṭa da jñānam ca

original: ghaṭādipasya ghaṭatvādiviśiṣṭe śaktirityadivṛttiviśeṣyakajñānānantaraṃ tatsamānākāra evaṃ saṃskāra utpadyate tādṛśasaṃskāraviśiṣṭaṃ padajñānaṃ śābdavodhe hetuḥ| nāgṛhītavṛttikasyeti| vṛttiviṣayakasaṃskārābhāvāt padāntaraviṣayakavṛttisattve'pi padāntarācchābdabodhavāraṇāya sāmānādhikaraṇyaniveśaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭa ādi pasya ghaṭa tva ādi viśiṣṭe śaktiḥ iti ādi vṛtti viśeṣyaka jñāna anantaram tad samāna ākāraḥ evam saṃskāraḥ utpadyate tādṛśa saṃskāra viśiṣṭam pada jñānam śābda vodhe hetuḥ na agṛhīta vṛttikasya iti vṛtti viṣayaka saṃskāra abhāvāt pada antara viṣayaka vṛtti sattve pi pada antarāt śābda bodha vāraṇāya sāmānādhikaraṇya niveśaḥ

original: sāmānādhikaraṇa yaṃ ca viṣayatayeva samāvāyenāpi bodhyam| nātaścaivatrīyaśaktihagrahānantaraṃ maitrasya śābdabodhaḥ| vispṛtavṛttikasyeti| bodha ityanenānvayaḥ| ud‌buddhasaṃskārābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|padājñānavata iti| tatra viṣayatayā jñānasyābhāvāt| hastaceṣṭādināpyarthavatvāttatrātivyāptivāraṇāya padaśabdaprayogaḥ|
analyzed: ca viṣayatayā iva samāvāyena api bodhyam maitrasya śābda bodhaḥ vispṛta vṛttikasya iti bodhaḥ iti anena anvayaḥ udbuddha saṃskāra abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ pada ajñānavataḥ iti tatra viṣayatayā jñānasya abhāvāt hasta ceṣṭā ādinā api arthavatvāt tatra ativyāpti vāraṇāya pada śabda prayogaḥ

original: tannirūpitavṛttyāśrayatvaniveśasya phalamāha| āśrayatveneti| tathāca śabdasyākāśaguṇātvāddhaṭādiśabdādākāśasyopasthitāvapi ākāśatvāvacchinnanirūpitavṛtterghaṭaḥ| diśabde 'bhāvānna tadbodha ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tad nirūpita vṛtti āśraya tva niveśasya phalam āha āśraya tvena iti tathā ca śabdasya ākāśa guṇā tvāt dhaṭa ādi śabdāt ākāśasya upasthitau api ākāśa tva avacchinna nirūpita vṛtteḥ ghaṭaḥ diśabde bhāvāt na tad bodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadyapi vṛttijñānasya padajñānasya vā abhāve kāraṇasamudāyarūpasāmagrīvirahādeva na kāryopattiḥ sambhavati tathāpi samudāyaghaṭakasambandajñānārthaṃ sāmānādhiraṇyaniveśaḥ| syādetat smṛtiṃ pratyanubhava eva kāraṇam upekṣātmakajñānāttu saṃskārānutpattyaivāsmaraṇasambhave kiṃ saṃskārahetutayā |
analyzed: yadi api vṛtti jñānasya pada jñānasya vā abhāve kāraṇa samudāya rūpa sāmagrī virahāt eva na kārya upattiḥ sambhavati tathā api samudāya ghaṭaka sambanda jñāna artham sāmānādhiraṇya niveśaḥ syāt etat smṛtim prati anubhavaḥ eva kāraṇam upekṣā ātmaka jñānāt tu saṃskāra anutpattyā eva asmaraṇa sambhave kim saṃskāra hetutayā

original: anyayā bhramaṇābhāvādeva ghaṭādīmānutpattau daṇḍādīnāmapi hetutānāmapi hetutānāpatteriti cenna| ud‌bodhakānāṃ tattadvyaktitvena hetutve gauravāllāghavena saṃskārasyaiva hetutvakalpanāt| vyāpāreṇa vyāpāriṇao nānyathāsiddhiriti pravādastu nirmūla eva| saṃskāraśabdenātra vāsanāviśeṣa ucyate na tu smṛtijatakatayā tārkikaprasiddhaḥ|
analyzed: anyayā bhramaṇa abhāvāt eva daṇḍa ādīnām api hetutānām api hetutā anāpatteḥ iti ced na udbodhakānām tad tad vyakti tvena hetu tve gauravāt lāghavena saṃskārasya eva hetu tva kalpanāt vyāpāreṇa na anyathā siddhiḥ iti pravādaḥ tu nirmūlaḥ eva saṃskāra śabdena atra vāsanā viśeṣaḥ ucyate na tu smṛti jatakatayā tārkika prasiddhaḥ

original: śābdabodhasya smṛtirūpatāyā nirākariṣyamāṇaṇatvāt| caitrādeśceti| asti hi padavyañjakatayā caitrāderūpasthitiḥ|
analyzed: śābda bodhasya smṛti rūpa tāyāḥ caitra ādeḥ ca iti asti hi pada vyañjaka tayā caitra ādeḥ ūpasthitiḥ

original: nanu ghaṭādipadavṛttyanubhavāvyadahitottaraṃ bodhānāpattiḥ tatpūrvaṃ saṃskārābhāvādata āha| saṃskārājānaketi| anubhavasya kṣaṇikatayā tatrāpi smaraṇādeva bodhāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu upekṣātmakaśaktyanubhavānantaraṃ saṃskārānutpattyā śābdabodhānāpattirata āha| teneti| nanu saṃskārasyātīndriyatayā tatsattvemānābhāva ityata āha| saṃskārakalpikā ceti|
analyzed: nanu bodha anāpattiḥ tat pūrvam saṃskāra abhāvāt atas āha saṃskāra ajānaka iti anubhavasya kṣaṇikatayā tatra api smaraṇāt eva bodhāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu upekṣā ātmaka śakti anubhava anantaram saṃskāra anutpattyā śābda bodha anāpattiḥ atas āha tena iti nanu saṃskārasya atīndriya tayā tad sattve māna abhāvaḥ iti atas āha saṃskāra kalpikā ca iti

original: smṛtirūpakāryeṇaiva kāraṇasya saṃskārasyānumānāt| yadyapi svarūpasadevakāraṇaṃ kāryajanakaṃ na jñātaṃ tathāpi kalpiketyasya hetutvakalpiketyarthaḥ| nanu saṃskārasya phalanāśyatvāt vṛttismṛtau saṃskārasya naṣṭatvāt śābdabodhānāpattirata āha| śābdabuddhireva veti| caramaphalasyaiva saṃskāranāśakatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: smṛti rūpa kāryeṇa eva kāraṇasya saṃskārasya anumānāt yadi api sva rūpa sat eva kāraṇam kārya janakam na jñātam tathā api kalpikā iti asya hetutva kalpikā iti arthaḥ nanu saṃskārasya phala nāśya tvāt vṛtti smṛtau saṃskārasya naṣṭa tvāt śābda bodha anāpattiḥ atas āha śābda buddhiḥ eva vā iti carama phalasya eva saṃskāra nāśaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nacaivaṃ smaraṇānantaraṃ punaḥ smaraṇānāpattiriti vācyam| tatra smāramasyaivasaṃskārajanakatvāt | taduktaṃ dīdhitau jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ smaramāt dṛḍhataraḥ saṃskāra iti|| 1.8 ||
analyzed: na ca evam smaraṇa anantaram punar smaraṇa anāpattiḥ iti vācyam tatra smāramasya eva saṃskāra janaka tvāt tat uktam dīdhitau jāyate ca punar punar smaramāt dṛḍhataraḥ saṃskāraḥ iti

original: vṛttistridheti| tridheti dhāpratyayaḥ prakāre| sata sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ| iha cavṛttitvaṃ sāmānyaṃ śaktitvādikviśeṣaḥ| tathā ca viśeṣatrayavatī vṛttirityarthaḥ| etacca svarūpakathanāmātram| śaktijñānalakṣaṇājñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvastveka eva|
analyzed: vṛttiḥ tridhā iti tridhā iti dhā pratyayaḥ prakāre sata sāmānyasya bhedakaḥ viśeṣaḥ iha sāmānyam tathā ca viśeṣa trayavatī vṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ etat ca svarūpa kathanā mātram śakti jñāna lakṣaṇa ajñānayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tu ekaḥ eva

original: tathā hi śaktitvācchinnasaṃsārgikaviṣayatānirūpitapadaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitārthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākajñānatvenaśābdavedhaṃ prati kāraṇatā śaktisambandhena śakyasambandhena vāpadaprakārakajñāne śakteḥ saṃsargatvāt| yatu śaktilakṣaṇānyataratvaṃ vṛttitvamiti tanna| dyotakānāmasaṅgrahāpatteḥ| tārkikamatanuvadati| asmācchabdāditi|
analyzed: tathā hi śakti tvāt chinna saṃsārgika viṣayatā nirūpita pada niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita artha niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka jñāna tvena śābdavedham prati kāraṇatā śakti sambandhena śakya sambandhena vā pada prakāraka jñāne śakteḥ saṃsarga tvāt yatu śakti lakṣaṇa anyataratvam vṛtti tvam iti tat na dyotakānām asaṅgraha āpatteḥ tārkikam atanu vadati asmāt śabdāt iti

original: nanu bodhyatvaprakārakeśvarecchāyāḥ śaktitve 'rthadharmatvāpattirityarucerāha | idamiti|
analyzed: nanu bodhya tva prakāraka īśvara icchāyāḥ śakti tve ṛtha dharma tva āpattiḥ iti aruceḥ āha idam iti

original: tasyāśceti| īśvarecchā pade 'rthe janyajanakabhāve ceti sarvatra śaktiprāptetyarthaḥ| yadyapi mukhyaviśeṣyatārthaniṣṭhaiva tathāpi lomavān paśupadād‌bodhya ita śaktigrahe murūyaviśeṣya tārahitasya lomāderapi bodhānna tathoktam| tasyāmiti| bodhajanakatvenecchāviṣayo vācaka ityādirarthaḥ| nātiprasaṅgaḥ| na sambandhādau vācakatvāpattiḥ|
analyzed: tasyāḥ ca iti īśvara icchā pade rthe janya janaka bhāve ca iti sarvatra śakti prāptā iti arthaḥ yadi api mukhya viśeṣyatā artha niṣṭhā eva tathā api lomavān paśu padāt bodhyaḥ śaktigrahe loma ādeḥ api bodhāt na tathā uktam tasyām iti bodha janaka tvena icchā viṣayaḥ vācakaḥ ityādiḥ arthaḥ na atiprasaṅgaḥ na sambandha ādau vācaka tva āpattiḥ

original: prathamaśaktigraha iti| bālānāṃ vākyādevārthabodhāt| āvāpaḥ| padāntaraprakṣepaḥ| udvāpaḥ| niṣkāśanam| ghaṭamānaya ghaṭaṃ naya ityādi | śāśtrakṛditi| padavibāgasya kālpanikatvāt vastuto ghaṭamānaya ghaṭaṃ nayetyādivākyamakhaṇḍameveti bhāvaḥ| yadyapi tārkikamate nākhaṇḍaṃ vākyaṃ tathāpi padavibhāgena kalpita evārthavibhāgaḥ|
analyzed: prathama śakti grahaḥ iti bālānām vākyāt eva artha bodhāt āvāpaḥ pada antara prakṣepaḥ udvāpaḥ niṣkāśanam ghaṭam ānaya ghaṭam naya ityādi śāśtra kṛt iti pada vibāgasya kālpanika tvāt vastutas ghaṭam ānaya ghaṭam naya ityādi vākyam akhaṇḍam eva iti bhāvaḥ yadi api tārkika mate na akhaṇḍam vākyam tathā api pada vibhāgena kalpitaḥ eva artha vibhāgaḥ

original: vākyevanaivārthasamāptiriti prāgevoktatvāt|

original: icchāyā janakatvasya veti yo hi ghaṭabhūtalayoḥ saṃyogavattadubhayasminnapi sambandhini vartate sa eva sambandho bhavati janakatvādi tu padamātravṛttītyubhayavṛttitvābhāvānna sambandhatvamityarthaḥ| icchāyā ubhayavṛttitvābhāvamupapādayati| iccheti| icchāviṣayo yo bodhastadīyaviṣayatāyā icchāśrayatāniyāmakatvābhāvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: icchāyāḥ janaka tvasya vā iti yaḥ hi ghaṭa bhū talayoḥ saṃyoga vat tad ubhayasmin api sambandhini vartate saḥ eva sambandhaḥ bhavati janaka tva ādi tu pada mātra vṛtti iti ubhaya vṛtti tva abhāvāt na sambandha tvam iti arthaḥ icchāyāḥ ubhaya vṛtti tva abhāvam upapādayati icchā iti icchā viṣayaḥ yaḥ bodhaḥ tadīya viṣayatāyāḥ icchā āśraya tā niyāmaka tva abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tatra hi na padaṃ nāpi padārthaṃ icchāviṣayaḥ kintu bodha eva bodhaviṣayatayaiva ca icchāśrayatā vācyā sā ca na sambhavati ayaṃ śabdaḥ ayamartho vā icchāvāniti pratītyabhāvaditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tatra hi na padam na api padārtham icchā viṣayaḥ kintu bodhaḥ eva bodha viṣaya tayā eva ca icchā āśraya tā vācyā sā ca na sambhavati ayam śabdaḥ ayam arthaḥ vā icchāvān iti pratīti abhāvat iti bhāvaḥ

original: sambandhatvābhāvaṃ vaktuṃ prathamataḥ sambandhasvarūpaṃ darśayati| sambandho hīti| yadyapi viśiṣṭabuddhiniyāmakatvaṃ viśepyaviśeṣaṇayorapi tathāpi tayoraviśiṣṭabuddhāvapi viṣayatvāttad‌vyudāsaḥ| ghaṭavad‌bhūtalamityādiviśiṣṭabuddhivatprakṛte viśiṣṭabuddhirnāstītyāha| na hīti| tatreti| icchāviṣayo yo bodhastadīyaviṣaye ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sambandha tva abhāvam vaktum prathamatas sambandha svarūpam darśayati sambandhaḥ hi iti yadi api viśiṣṭa buddhi niyāmaka tvam viśepya viśeṣaṇayoḥ api tathā api tayoḥ aviśiṣṭa buddhau api viṣaya tvāt tad vyudāsaḥ ghaṭavat bhū talam ityādi viśiṣṭa buddhi vat prakṛte viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ na asti iti āha na hi iti tatra iti icchā viṣayaḥ yaḥ bodhaḥ tadīya viṣaye iti arthaḥ

original: nanu śabdavadarthasyāpi śābdabodhe nimittatvādastyubhayatra bodhajanakatvākhya, sambandha ityata āha| sattve'pīti| durupapādatvāditi| na hi daṇḍacakrayorubhayorghaṭajanakatve 'pi parasparaṃ sambandhostītyarthaḥ| sambandhābhāvāditi pāṭhe 'pyayamevārthaḥ| etadevāha| jñāne iti|
analyzed: nanu śabda vat arthasya api śābda bodhe nimitta tvāt asti ubhayatra bodha janaka tva ākhya sambandhaḥ iti atas āha sattve api iti durupapāda tvāt iti na hi daṇḍa cakrayoḥ ubhayoḥ ghaṭa janaka tve pi parasparam sambandhaḥ usti iti arthaḥ sambandha abhāvāt iti pāṭhe pi ayam eva arthaḥ etat eva āha jñāne iti

original: yasya guṇasya bhāvāt dravye śabdābhiniveśa iti bhāṣyamate guṇo nāma bhedakaḥ bhedyañca dvavyamityetadeva lakṣaṇamanusaraṇīyam| evañca viśeṣyamātravācakādviśeṣaṇamātre guṇe bhāvapratyayaḥ| gośabdasya jātyavicchinnadravyavācitve jātau gotvamiti bhāvapratyayaḥ| jātimātravācitve tu tatsamaniyate śabdasvarūpe bhavapratyayaḥ|

original: pramāṇatveneti| pramāṇatvena lakṣito yaḥ śabdastasmājjātasya pratyayasyetyarthaḥ| evaṃ cāpabhraṃśajasyāpi sāmayikatvaṃ tulyamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu vedārthasya samāyaprakāśitatvaṃ sambhavati vṛddhavyavahāraiḥ śaktigrahe'pi vedavākyasya samudāyāntatvādarthenājñātasambandhatvāttatkalpane saṅketāpātātsāpekṣatvenā prāmāṇyāpattirata āha| samayagṛhīteti|

original: lokavedayorarthamedābhāvādvedavākyasyāpi laukikavyutpattimūlakatvena saṅketānapekṣatvādanapekṣameva prāṇāṇyam| ṛṣīṇāmiti| vedavākyānāṃ sāmayikārthabodhakatvavirodhenetyarthaḥ| nanu dīnaṃ tvāmanunāthate stanayugaṃ yatrānṛtaṃ mā kṛthā ityatrātmanepadasyāsādhutve'pyadoṣaḥ kratorbahiradoṣādityata āha| kāvye iti|

original: nanu aśvaśabdo vājini sādhurityeva sādhutāyā arthaviśeṣaniyantritatvāttīrādau gaṃgādipadasya sādhusvānāpattirata āha| lākṣaṇikeṣvapīti| nanu kathaṃ tīrabodha ityata āha| padānyara iti| tatra tīre pravāhatvamevāropyate, anyathā śabdārthasambandhasyānityatvāpattiriti bhāvaḥ|

original: evañca pravāhatvaprakārakapratītiviśeṣyaprasiddhārthatvaṃ mukhyatvaṃ tādṛśāprasiddhārthatvaṃ ca gauṇatvaṃ bodhyam| nanu gopālananimittasya gopaśabdasya striyāṃ vṛttyabhāvādāropitagopatvavatyāśca ṅīṣaḥ pratyupasthāpakābhāvātkathaṃ tadanuśāśanamata āha| gopītyādāviti|

original: yā hi svayaṃ gāḥ pālayati tatra gopaityave bhavati pālanakriyārahitāyāṃ gopabhāryāyāṃ taddharmalābhādropaśabdaḥ prayucyate| etena puṃyoge ajīti vadantaḥ parāstāḥ | tatra jātereva nimittatvena taddharmalābhasya nimittatvaṃ nāstīti puṃyogāsambhavāt| nanu pūrvaṃ strībodhābhāvātkathaṃ ṅīṣaḥ prāptista āha| prakriyeti|
analyzed: yā hi svayam gāḥ pālayati tatra bhavati pālana kriyā rahitāyām gopa bhāryāyām tad dharma lābhāt ropa śabdaḥ prayucyate etena pum yoge ajī iti vadantaḥ parāstāḥ tatra jāteḥ eva nimitta tvena tad dharma lābhasya nimitta tvam na asti iti pum yoga asambhavāt nanu pūrvam strī bodha abhāvāt katham ṅīṣaḥ prāptiḥ te āha prakriyā iti

original: tatstriyāṃ gopatvāropeṇa ḍīṣo nimittaṃ strībodhakatvaṃ prakriyādaśāyāmānumānikamityarthaḥ| nanu tīrādipadavadatratātparyagrāhakābhāvādākṣepe kiṃ bījamata āha| iti śāstrata iti|
analyzed: tad striyām gopa tva āropeṇa ḍīṣaḥ nimittam strī bodhaka tvam prakriyā daśāyām ānumānikam iti arthaḥ nanu tīra ādi pada vat atra tātparya grāhaka abhāvāt ākṣepe kim bījam atas āha iti śāstrataḥ iti

original: puṃyogāditi śāstrātstrītvabodha iti yaduktaṃ tatra mānamāha| liṅgamiti| pratyayaśāśakaṃ puṃyogāditi sūtraṃ strīliṅgajñāne liṅgamanumāpakamityarthaḥ| atredaṃ tattvaṃgopālanarahitāyāṃ gopyāṃ gopaśabdasya vṛttau dampatibhāvasambandha eva nimittam|
analyzed: pum yogāt iti śāstrāt strī tva bodhaḥ iti yat uktam tatra mānam āha liṅgam iti pum yogāt iti sūtram strī liṅga jñāne liṅgam anumāpakam iti arthaḥ atra idam tattvaṃgopālana rahitāyām gopyām gopa śabdasya vṛttau dampati bhāva sambandhaḥ eva nimittam

original: yathā hi gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra sāmīpyasambandhāttīre vṛttiḥ mañcāḥ krośantītyatra saṃyoga eva sambandhaḥ āyurghṛtamityatra janakatvaṃ, tathā devakī ityādau janyajanakabhāvasambandhenaiva duhitari vṛttiḥ| nirūḍhaścāyaṃ vyavahāra iti na sambandhāntaramākṣipyātiprasaṅga āpādyaḥ| itthameva jagadīśītyādayaḥ prayogāḥ|
analyzed: yathā hi gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra sāmīpya sambandhāt tīre vṛttiḥ mañcāḥ krośanti iti atra saṃyogaḥ eva sambandhaḥ āyuḥ ghṛtam iti atra janaka tvam tathā devakī ityādau janya janaka bhāva sambandhena eva duhitari vṛttiḥ nirūḍhaḥ ca ayam vyavahāraḥ iti na sambandha antaram ākṣipya atiprasaṅgaḥ āpādyaḥ ittham eva jagadīśī ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ

original: evañcadevadattādiśabdānāṃ svata eva strīyāṃ vṛttisambhavena puṃyogābhāvāṭṭābeva| jātyantarīyāyāṃ śūdrabhāryāyāṃ śūdraśabdasya pravṛttau tu śūdrasambandha eva nimittamiti| puṃśabdaṃ puṃvācake gopaśabde prakriyādaśāyāṃ bodhakatvamānumitikamevetyatra mānamāha| ata eveti|
analyzed: evam ca devadatta ādi śabdānām svatas eva vṛtti sambhavena pum yoga abhāvāt ṭāp eva jāti antarīyāyām śūdra bhāryāyām śūdra śabdasya pravṛttau tu śūdra sambandhaḥ eva nimittam iti pum śabdam pum vācake gopa śabde prakriyā daśāyām bodhaka tvam ānumitikam eva iti atra mānam āha atas eva iti

original: ayambhāvaḥ yadi tibādividhāveva vyākaraṇasya tātparyaṃ tadā sādhvanuśāsanatvabhaṅgaḥ, ataḥ sādhutvaviśiṣṭāstibādayo virdhāyante| nanu laḍādīnāṃ prayogābhāvātkathaṃ sādhutvaviśiṣṭasya vidhānamiti cedevaṃ tarhi vartamāne laḍ bhavati tena ca yat pariniṣṭhitaṃ tatsādhu ityartha iti| arthāpattīti| arthasya upapādakasya āpattiḥ kalpanā|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ yadi tip ādi vidhau eva vyākaraṇasya tātparyam tadā sādhu anuśāsana tva bhaṅgaḥ atas sādhu tva viśiṣṭāḥ tip ādayaḥ nanu laṭ ādīnām prayoga abhāvāt katham sādhu tva viśiṣṭasya vidhānam iti ced evam tarhi vartamāne laṭ bhavati tena ca yat pariniṣṭhitam tat sādhu iti arthaḥ iti arthāpatti iti arthasya upapādakasya āpattiḥ kalpanā

original: yathā pīno devadatta ityatra pīnatvānyathānupapattyā rātribhojanaṃ kalpyate||1.26 ||
analyzed: yathā pīnaḥ devadattaḥ iti atra pīna tva anyathā anupapattyā rātri bhojanam kalpyate

original: kiñceti| śaktau rajatamidaṃ neti bādhaniścayānantaraṃ pūrvajñānasya bhramatvaṃ kalpyate apabhraṃśaniṣṭhaśaktyaṃśe tu kasyāpi bādhādarśanānna bhramatvasambhava ityarthaḥ| tadabhāvaniścayāditi| ṛṣīṇāṃ bhramābhāvena śaktyabhāvaniścayādityarthaḥ| pramāṇānām| jñāyamānaśabdānām| teṣāmapi| apabhraṃśānāmapi| ata eva|
analyzed: kiñca iti śaktau rajatam idam na iti bādha niścaya anantaram pūrva jñānasya bhrama tvam kalpyate apabhraṃśa niṣṭha śakti aṃśe tu kasya api bādhā darśanāt na bhrama tva sambhavaḥ iti arthaḥ tad abhāva niścayāt iti ṛṣīṇām bhrama abhāvena śakti abhāva niścayāt iti arthaḥ pramāṇānām jñāyamāna śabdānām teṣām api apabhraṃśānām api atas eva

original: apabhraṃśānāmapyarthasaṃbandhasattvādeva| dharmārthatvamiti| na tu bodhakatvamuktamityarthaḥ| arthāyahyeta iti| ete śabdā arthabodhāya ucyante ityarthaḥ| jaiminisūtrasyāpīti | tatra hi prayogotpattyaśāstratvācchabdeṣu na vyavasthāsyāditi pūrvapakṣasūtraṃ prayoganiyamo na syādityarthaḥ| siddhāntasūtramāha| anyāyo 'neketi| śabde iti|
analyzed: apabhraṃśānām api artha saṃbandha sattvāt eva dharma artha tvam iti na tu bodhaka tvam uktam iti arthaḥ arthāya hi ete iti ete śabdāḥ artha bodhāya ucyante iti arthaḥ jaimini sūtrasya api iti tatra hi prayoga utpatti aśāstra tvāt śabdeṣu na vyavasthāsyāt iti pūrvapakṣa sūtram prayoga niyamaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ siddhānta sūtram āha anyāyaḥ neka iti śabde iti

original: prayoktavye iti śeṣaḥ| prayatnaniṣpatteraparādhaḥ prayatnāntarasyotpattiḥ prayoga ityuktam|| 1.27 ||
analyzed: prayoktavye iti śeṣaḥ prayatna niṣpatteḥ aparādhaḥ prayatna antarasya utpattiḥ prayogaḥ iti uktam

original: gagaryādīnāmapīti| gośabdāpabhraṃśatayotyarthaḥ| goyādiśabdānāmiti| gośabdāpabhraṃśatayetyarthaḥ| vede tu sādhuriti| vibhaktivyatyayāditi bhāvaḥ| patañjalineti| samānāyāmarthāvagatau śabdaiścāpaśabdaiśceti vārtikaṃ vyācakṣāṇenetyarthaḥ|| 1.28 ||
analyzed: gagarī ādīnām api iti go śabda apabhraṃśatayā uti arthaḥ goya ādi śabdānām iti go śabda apabhraṃśatayā iti arthaḥ vede tu sādhuḥ iti vibhakti vyatyayāt iti bhāvaḥ patañjalinā iti samānāyām artha avagatau śabdaiḥ ca apaśabdaiḥ ca iti vārtikam vyācakṣāṇena iti arthaḥ

original: yarvāma iti| tannāmāna ityarthaḥ| nanu gagarīśabdādibhyo'pi sorutpattyāpattirata āha| prakṛtipratyayayoriti| śāstraviṣayatve iti| śāstrīyoddeśyatāvacchedakavatve ityarthaḥ| ghaṭa ityasyaiveti| tathā cārthabodhakatvasattve'pi ekatvaviśiṣṭārthasya pratyaiva kroḍīkārānna tataḥ suriti bhāvaḥ| asādhureveti|
analyzed: iti tad nāmānaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu gagarī śabda ādibhyaḥ api soḥ utpatti āpattiḥ atas āha prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti śāstra viṣaya tve iti śāstrīya uddeśya tā avacchedakavatve iti arthaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti asya eva iti tathā ca artha bodhaka tva sattve api ekatva viśiṣṭa arthasya kroḍīkārāt na tatas suḥ iti bhāvaḥ asādhuḥ eva iti

original: śrutau tu asādhvanukaraṇasyāpi sādhutvānna doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| arthavattveneti| sādhava evārthavantaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāviṣayā ityarthaḥ| ata eveti | yato 'nuśiṣṭaprakṛteḥ prayujyamāna eva pratyayaḥ sādhurata evetyarthaḥ| vṛttijasādṛśye'pīti na kevalaḥ pratyaya ityasya pratyayasajātīya ityartha iti bhāvaḥ| niyameneti|
analyzed: śrutau tu asādhu anukaraṇasya api sādhu tvāt na doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ arthavat tvena iti sādhavaḥ eva arthavantaḥ prātipadika saṃjñā viṣayāḥ iti arthaḥ atas eva iti yatas nu śiṣṭa prakṛteḥ prayujyamānaḥ eva pratyayaḥ sādhuḥ atas eva iti arthaḥ vṛtti ja sādṛśye api iti na kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ iti asya pratyaya sajātīyaḥ iti arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ niyamena iti

original: ṅyāpprātipadikāditi pañcamīnirdeśādeva pratyayānāṃ paratve siddhe 'pītyādiḥ | asve | daridre | tadvodhakam| sādhutvabodhakam| dharmaniyamaḥ| dharmārtho niyamaḥ| asādhuranumānena vācakaḥ kaiścidiṣyata iti pūrvārdhe nāpabhraśānāmavācakatvamabhidhāya harirmatāntaramāha| bācakatvāviśeṣe'pīti|
analyzed: ṅī āp prātipadikāt iti pañcamī nirdeśāt eva pratyayānām paratve siddhe pi ityādiḥ asve daridre tad vodhakam sādhu tva bodhakam dharma niyamaḥ dharma arthaḥ niyamaḥ asādhuḥ anumānena vācakaḥ kaiścid iṣyate iti pūrva ardhe na apabhraśānām avācaka tvam abhidhāya hariḥ mata antaram āha bācaka tva aviśeṣe pi iti

original: astu vā apabhraṃśādarthāvagamaḥ śāstreṇa tu puṇyapāpaniyamaḥ kriyate sādhubhirevārtho vaktavyo nāsādhubhirevaṃ hi kriyamāṇamabhyudakāri bhavatīti||1.29 ||
analyzed: astu vā apabhraṃśāt artha avagamaḥ śāstreṇa tu puṇya pāpa niyamaḥ kriyate sādhubhiḥ eva arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ na asādhubhiḥ evam hi kriyamāṇam abhyudakāri bhavati iti

original: saṅkara iti| kevalasādhutvaṃ sādhugakāre kevalakatvamasādhukakāre ubhayamityarthaḥ| yayorjātyoriti| yathā naratvasiṃhatvayorekatra samāveśānnarasiṃhatvaṃ bhinnamityarthaḥ| bhedabhaṅga eveti| naratvāśrayo 'nyaḥ siṃhatvāśrayaścānya ityevaṃ bhedasyāsiddhirevetyarthaḥ| ata eva guṇagatajātau sāṅkaryaṃ na doṣāyeti na samāhitam| aśvatare iti|
analyzed: saṅkaraḥ iti kevala sādhu tvam sādhu gakāre kevalaka tvam asādhu kakāre ubhayam iti arthaḥ yayoḥ jātyoḥ iti yathā nara tva siṃha tvayoḥ ekatra samāveśāt nara siṃha tvam bhinnam iti arthaḥ bheda bhaṅgaḥ eva iti nara tva āśrayaḥ nyaḥ siṃha tva āśrayaḥ ca anyaḥ iti evam bhedasya asiddhiḥ eva iti arthaḥ atas eva guṇa gata jātau sāṅkaryam na doṣāya iti na samāhitam aśvatare iti

original: tatrāśvatvagardabhatvayoḥ saṅkaraḥ| yayostviti| pṛthivītvadravyātvayoḥ samāveśasyādūṣaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tatra aśva tva gardabha tvayoḥ saṅkaraḥ yayoḥ tu iti pṛthivī tva dravyā tvayoḥ samāveśasya adūṣaṇa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: spandasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatayā mūrtatvaṃ jātiḥ tatsāṅkaryād bhūtatvaṃ na jātiḥ ākāśe bhūtapadavyavahārastu bahirindriyagrāhyaviśeṣagugavatvaprayukto bhāktaḥ| mānābhāvāditi|
analyzed: spanda samavāyi kāraṇatā avacchedaka tayā mūrta tvam jātiḥ tad sāṅkaryāt bhūta tvam na jātiḥ ākāśe bhūta pada vyavahāraḥ tu bahis indriya grāhya viśeṣa gugavatva prayuktaḥ bhāktaḥ māna abhāvāt iti

original: svasāmānādhikaraṇyasvābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyobhayasambandhena jātiviśiṣṭajātitvāvacchedena svasamānādhikaraṇābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvābhāvaniyamasya bhaṅgaprasaṅga iti taduktistu niryuktiketi bhāvaḥ| śarīratve ceti| kevalapṛthivītvaṃ ghaṭādau kevalaśarīratvaṃ taijasādiśarīre asmadādiśarīre cobhayamiti sāṅkaryāt śarīratvaṃ na jātiriti tārkikāḥ|
analyzed: sva sāmānādhikaraṇya sva abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇya ubhaya sambandhena jāti viśiṣṭa jāti tva avacchedena sva samāna adhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tva abhāva niyamasya bhaṅga prasaṅgaḥ iti tad uktiḥ tu niryuktikā iti bhāvaḥ śarīra tve ca iti kevala pṛthivī tvam ghaṭa ādau kevala śarīra tvam taijasa ādi śarīre asmat ādi śarīre ca ubhayam iti sāṅkaryāt śarīra tvam na jātiḥ iti tārkikāḥ

original: rājājñāstīti| lāghavarūpayuktestulyatvāt| ata eva jalapadaśakyatāvacchedakatayā jalatvaṃ jātiriti vardhamānaḥ | yattu dravyavṛttikapālādau dravyāntarotpattivāraṇāya tatpribandhakatāvacchedakatayā bhūtatvajātiriti tanna| mūrtatvamādāya vinigamanāvirahāt|| 1.30 ||
analyzed: rājājñā asti iti lāghava rūpa yukteḥ tulya tvāt atas eva jala pada śakyatā avacchedaka tayā jala tvam jātiḥ iti vardhamānaḥ yat tu dravya vṛtti kapāla ādau dravya antara utpatti vāraṇāya tad pribandhaka tā avacchedaka tayā bhūta tva jātiḥ iti tat na mūrta tvam ādāya vinigamana avirahāt

original: asādhutvameveti| śāstravyavahāramārgeṇaiva nāmakaraṇāt| nanu sarve sarvārthavācakā iti mate vṛddhirādaujityādīnāṃ niyāmakatayā vidhitvābhāvādādhunikasaṃjñātvāsaṅgatirata āha| sarvārthavācakatve'pīti| ayambhāvaḥ śabdārthasambandho yogyatālakṣaṇo'bhipretaḥ| sarvo hi śabdaḥ saṃjñātvena viniyujyamāno yogyatvātsarvatrārthe sambaddhaḥ|
analyzed: asādhu tvam eva iti śāstra vyavahāra mārgeṇa eva nāmakaraṇāt nanu sarve sarva artha vācakāḥ iti mate vṛddhiḥ ādau jiti ādīnām niyāmaka tayā vidhi tva abhāvāt ādhunika saṃjñā tva asaṅgatiḥ atas āha sarva artha vācaka tve pi iti ayam bhāvaḥ śabda artha sambandhaḥ yogyatā lakṣaṇa ubhipretaḥ sarvaḥ hi śabdaḥ saṃjñā tvena viniyujyamānaḥ yogya tvāt sarvatra arthe sambaddhaḥ

original: śaktyavacchedamātre tu saṃjñākarturvyāpāraḥ śabdārthasambandhasya nityatvāt| evañca śaktyavacchedānniyamatvamajñātaśāktiprakāśakatvācca vidhitvamapīti| vyavahārāyeti| kvacitsaṃjñini saṃjñāyā niyamo vyavahārāyetyarthaḥ| ḍitthādyarthe ḍitthādipadasambandho nitya eva, gavādaugośabdādīnāmivetyarthaḥ| taditi| niyamaparamityatrānvayaḥ|
analyzed: śakti avaccheda mātre tu saṃjñā kartuḥ vyāpāraḥ śabda artha sambandhasya nitya tvāt evam ca śakti avacchedāt niyama tvam ajñāta śākti prakāśaka tvāt ca vidhi tvam api iti vyavahārāya iti kvacid saṃjñini saṃjñāyāḥ niyamaḥ vyavahārāya iti arthaḥ ḍittha ādi arthe ḍittha ādi pada sambandhaḥ nityaḥ eva gavādau go śabda ādīnām iva iti arthaḥ tat iti niyama param iti atra anvayaḥ

original: vaktricchāyā iti| nanvevaṃ śabdārthasambandhasyānityatvāpattiriti cenna| vāktricchayā śaktiprakāśanamityarthāt| aijādipade kutvādyāpādanaṃ saṅgamayati vṛddhirādaijityādīnāṃ lokaprayuktatvarūpalaukikatvābhāvādāha | vedamātreti| laukikatvāditi| laukikaprayoge śāstrapravṛtterāvaśyakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| sūktavāketi|
analyzed: vaktri chāyāḥ iti nanu evam śabda artha sambandhasya anitya tva āpattiḥ iti ced na vāktri chayā śakti prakāśanam iti arthāt aija ādi pade ku tva ādi āpādanam saṅgamayati vṛddhiḥ ādai jiti ādīnām loka prayukta tva rūpa laukika tva abhāvāt āha veda mātra iti laukika tvāt iti laukika prayoge śāstra pravṛtteḥ āvaśyaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ sūktavāka iti

original: amukaśarmā āyurāśāste ityādisūktavākaprayogo yāgeṣu saṅkalpaśca yadyapi mānaso vyāpārastathāpi śabdaprayoga eva tathaiva vidhānāt| antarantasthamiti| antaḥ madhye antasthā yaralavā yasya || 1.31 ||
analyzed: amuka śarmā āyuḥ āśāste ityādi sūktavāka prayogaḥ yāgeṣu saṅkalpaḥ ca yadi api mānasaḥ vyāpāraḥ tathā api śabda prayogaḥ eva tathā eva vidhānāt antar antastham iti antar madhye antasthāḥ yasya

original: agnyādīti| agnyādayo nakṣaṇatrāṇāṃ devatāḥ | etābhiriti| agnidattetyādivat| jyautiṣoktamiti| aśvinyādicaraṇākṣareṇa kṛtaṃ cūḍāmaṇirityādikaṃ ca nāma yajñakarmopayogītyarthaḥ| tathaivoktamiti| nākṣatraṃ nāma idamevoktamityarthaḥ| prakaraṇe iti| uktamityatrānvayaḥ | nāma ceti| cakāreṇa nāmāntarasamuccayaḥ| nirdiśati| likhati| rahasyamiti|

original: nanu chatripadācchatribidhe kathamanyabodhaḥ , acchatribodhe ca svārthasya parityāga evetyata āha| tadaparityāgaśceti| tathāca ubhayasādhāraṇarūpeṇa śakyalakṣyayorekatrānvayesetyarthaḥ| yena kenāpīti| viśeṣyatayā kriyānvayaḥ sā ajahatsvārthā| yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyādau tu jahatsvārthaiveti tārkikoktaṃ nirākartṛmāha|
analyzed: nanu chatri padāt chatri bidhe katham anya bodhaḥ a chatri bodhe ca sva arthasya parityāgaḥ eva iti atas āha tad aparityāgaḥ ca iti tathā ca ubhaya sādhāraṇa rūpeṇa śakya lakṣyayoḥ ekatra anvaye iti arthaḥ yena kena api iti viśeṣya tayā kriyā anvayaḥ sā ajahatsvārthāḥ yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya ityādau tu jahatsvārthā eva iti tārkika uktam nirākartṛm āha

original: kuntavaditi kuntini puruṣe kunto viśeṣaṇam| tathāca kuntināmiva viśeṣaṇatayā kuntānāmapi praveśe'nvayaḥ| tīkṣṇatvaṃ casādhāraṇo dharmaḥ| kākebhyo dadhītyāderajahatvasvārthatvopapādanena tṛtīyaprakāratvaṃ nirākaroti| dadhyupaghātakatayeti|
analyzed: kunta vat iti kuntini puruṣe kuntaḥ viśeṣaṇam tathā ca kuntinām iva viśeṣaṇa tayā kuntānām api praveśa invayaḥ tīkṣṇa tvam ca sādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ kākebhyaḥ dadhi ityādeḥ ajahatva svārtha tva upapādanena tṛtīya prakāra tvam nirākaroti dadhi upaghātaka tayā iti

original: atreti| gosadṛśe lakṣaṇāyāṃ gorapi viśeṣaṇatve 'pītyarthaḥ| nanu gotvameva bāhīke āropyata iti mate kathaṃ svārthasya tyāga iti cetpratyekaṃ jātīnāṃ vyāpakatve 'pi yatrābhivyaktāstatraiva kāryasādhakā iti vakṣyamāṇatvena tadrityā svārthatyāgāt|
analyzed: atra iti go sadṛśe lakṣaṇāyām goḥ api viśeṣaṇa tve pi iti arthaḥ nanu go tvam eva bāhīke āropyate iti mate katham svārthasya tyāgaḥ iti ced pratyekam jātīnām vyāpaka tve pi yatra abhivyaktāḥ tatra eva kārya sādhakāḥ iti vakṣyamāṇa tvena tadrityā svārtha tyāgāt

original: nanu kuśalādipade'pi svārthabodhapūrvakapadārtho bhavati vivecakatve ca sambandho 'pyastīti nirūḍhalakṣaṇātvāpattirata āha| asati prayojane iti| yathā hi śaityapāvantavādipratītaye gaṅgāpadena tīraṃ lakṣyate naivaṃ rūḍhisthale ityarthaḥ| anvayeti| tathāca kuśalaśabde'vayavārthanusandhāne nirūḍhalakṣaṇānusandhāne tu rūḍhireva|
analyzed: nanu kuśala ādi pade api svārtha bodha pūrvaka padārthaḥ bhavati vivecaka tve ca sambandhaḥ pi asti iti nirūḍha lakṣaṇā tva āpattiḥ atas āha asati prayojane iti yathā hi śaitya pāvantava ādi pratītaye gaṅgā padena tīram lakṣyate na evam rūḍhi sthale iti arthaḥ anvaya iti tathā ca kuśala śabda ivayava artha anusandhāne nirūḍha lakṣaṇa anusandhāne tu rūḍhiḥ eva

original: nanu kathaṃ śuddhaiva dvidhā gauṇyā api bhedadvayasambhavāt| tathāhi gaurbāhīka ityatra jahatsvārthā gobāhīkobhayatātparyake ete gāva ānīyantāmityādāvajahatsvārtheti cetsatyam| atra sambandhaḥ sādṛśyamanyo vā| ādye śakyasādṛśyasya śakyāvṛttitayā kathaṃ śakyasya lakṣyatvaṃ yenājahatsvārthanatā syāt|
analyzed: nanu katham śuddhā eva dvidhā gauṇyāḥ api bheda dvaya sambhavāt tathā hi gauḥ bāhīkaḥ iti atra jahat svārthā go bāhīka ubhaya tātparyake ete gāvaḥ ānīyantām ityādau ajahat svārthā iti ced satyam atra sambandhaḥ sādṛśyam anyaḥ vā ādye śakya sādṛśyasya śakya āvṛtti tayā katham śakyasya lakṣya tvam yena ajahatsvārthanatā syāt

original: dvitīye tu sādṛśyasambandhā bhāve gauṇītvameva na syāt| kuntānāmiti| tātparyāviṣayekuntipraveśe kuntānāmanvayabādhādityanvayaḥ|
analyzed: dvitīye tu sādṛśya sambandhā bhāve gauṇī tvam eva na syāt kuntānām iti tātparya viṣaye kunti praveśe kuntānām anvaya bādhāt iti anvayaḥ

original: gosādṛśyamiti| upamitasamāse eva sādṛśyaṃ lakṣyatāvacchedakamityanye nanu gāvābhedasya bādhitatvātkathaṃ tatpratītirata āha| vyañjanājanyeti | bādhajñānaṃ tu niścayātmakameva pratibandhakaṃ vādhasaṃśayānantaramapi viśeṣadarśane tadvattābuddheḥ apratibandhakatve bījamāha| evañceti| anāhāryajñānasyaiva pratibadhyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| bhedaketi|
analyzed: go sādṛśyam iti upamita samāse eva sādṛśyam lakṣya tā avacchedakam iti anye nanu gāvā bhedasya bādhita tvāt katham tad pratītiḥ atas āha vyañjana ajanya iti bādha jñānam tu niścaya ātmakam eva pratibandhakam vādha saṃśaya anantaram api viśeṣa darśane tadvat tā buddheḥ apratibandhaka tve bījam āha evam ca iti anāhārya jñānasya eva pratibadhya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ bhedaka iti

original: gotvabāhīkatvayorbhedakatvāt| madhye iti| vākyarthabodhāt prāgityarthaḥ| taṭādīnāṃ pratipādane kṛte tatpratītyābhede sati pāvanatvādilābha iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: go tva bāhīka tvayoḥ bhedaka tvāt madhye iti vākya artha bodhāt prāk iti arthaḥ taṭa ādīnām pratipādane kṛte tad pratītya abhede sati pāvana tva ādi lābhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: upakṛtamiti| upakṛtaṃ bahu nāma kimucyate sujanatā prathitā bhavatā paramityatrāpakāriṇaṃ pratiupakṛtamityapakāraṃ lakṣayati| gośabdasya jāḍyādiparatve gorjāḍyamiti pratityāpattirnāmārthayorabheda iti nyāyavirodhaścetyabhipretyāha| kecittviti| ayambhāvaḥ gavābhinneo bāhīka iti bodhe abhedasya bādhitatvādrośabdena gosadṛśaṃ lakṣyam|
analyzed: upakṛtam iti upakṛtam bahu nāma kim ucyate su jana tā prathitā bhavatā param iti atra apakāriṇam prati upakṛtam iti apakāram lakṣayati go śabdasya jāḍya ādi paratve goḥ jāḍyam iti prati tyāpattiḥ nāma arthayoḥ abhedaḥ iti nyāya virodhaḥ ca iti abhipretya āha kecid tu iti ayam bhāvaḥ iti bodhe abhedasya bādhita tvāt ro śabdena go sadṛśam lakṣyam

original: gosādṛśyaṃ ca gogatajāḍyamāndyādi| tathāca jaḍābhinno bāhīka iti bodha iti| ata eva śaṅkate| paunarukyamiti| śakyādaśakyopasthitirlakṣaṇeti mate tu lākṣaṇikaṃ nānubhāvakamiti pravādaḥ| tathāca gaṅgāpadāttīrānupasthitau tatra saptamyarthānvayānāpattiḥ pratyayānaṃ prakṛtyarthānviteti nyāyāt| tārkikāṇāmaya pravādaḥ kathamiti cet|
analyzed: go sādṛśyam ca go gata jāḍya māndya ādi tathā ca jaḍa abhinnaḥ bāhīkaḥ iti bodhaḥ iti atas eva śaṅkate paunarukyam iti śakyāt aśakya upasthitiḥ lakṣaṇā iti mate tu lākṣaṇikam na anubhāvakam iti pravādaḥ tathāca gaṅgā padāt tīra anupasthitau tatra saptamī artha anvaya anāpattiḥ pratyayānam prakṛti artha anvitā iti nyāyāt tārkikāṇām aya pravādaḥ katham iti ced

original: uddeśyavidheyabhāvena lākṣaṇikaṃ nānubhāvapakamiti tadarthaḥ| ata eva na vidhau paraḥ śabdārtha iti pravādaḥ |pare tu kumatiḥ paśurityādau sarvalākṣaṇike 'nvayadarśanāllākṣaṇikaṃ nānubhāpavakamiti pravādo'saṅgata evetyāhuḥ|
analyzed: uddeśya vidheya bhāvena lākṣaṇikam na anubhāvapakam iti tad arthaḥ atas eva na vidhau paraḥ śabda arthaḥ iti pravādaḥ pare tu kumatiḥ paśuḥ ityādau sarva lākṣaṇike nvaya darśanāt lākṣaṇikam na anubhāpavakam iti pravāda usaṅgataḥ eva iti āhuḥ

original: nanu sādhāraṇadharmāśraye lakṣaṇāyāmālhādayati mukhendurityatra paunaruktyāpattiriti cedatārahurindupadasya indravṛttidharmavati lakṣaṇeti|
analyzed: nanu sādhāraṇa dharma āśraye lakṣaṇāyām ālhādayati mukha induḥ iti atra paunaruktya āpattiḥ iti ced atārahuḥ indu padasya indra vṛtti dharmavati lakṣaṇā iti

original: sadṛśatvena lakṣameti| sadṛśe lakṣaṇetyarthaḥ| sādṛśyasyeti| jaḍatve eva sādṛśyāparyavasānāttenaiva rūpeṇa lakṣamāstvityarthaḥ| svaśakyagateti| gavādipadārthagotatvādisahacāriṇo jāḍyādayo lakṣyanta ityarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ gaurbāhīka ityatra sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattirata āha| jātiśaktinaye iti|
analyzed: sadṛśa tvena lakṣam eti sadṛśe lakṣaṇā iti arthaḥ sādṛśyasya iti jaḍa tve eva sādṛśya aparyavasānāt tena eva rūpeṇa lakṣam āstu iti arthaḥ sva śakya gata iti go ādi padārtha go tatva ādi sahacāriṇaḥ jāḍya ādayaḥ lakṣyante iti arthaḥ nanu evam gauḥ bāhīkaḥ iti atra sāmānādhikaraṇya anupapattiḥ atas āha jāti śakti naye iti

original: tathāca dviguṇasadṛśajāḍyākṣiptaṃ pravṛttinimittīkṛtya gośabde bāhīke vartata ityarthaḥ| parāstamiti| sādhāraṇaṃ jāḍyādilakṣyatāvacchedakamāśritya tadāśraya eva lakṣaṇāyā ucitatvāt| anyathā lakṣyamāmavyadhikaraṇatvamaśakyasya bāhīkasya gośabdena pratipādanāsambhavaśca | tadāhuḥ lakṣyamāṇaguṇairyogādvṛtteriṣṭā tu gauṇateti|
analyzed: tathā ca dviguṇa sadṛśa jāḍya ākṣiptam pravṛtti nimittīkṛtya go śabde bāhīke vartate iti arthaḥ parāstam iti sādhāraṇam jāḍya ādi lakṣya tā avacchedakam āśritya tad āśraye eva lakṣaṇāyāḥ ucitatvāt anyathā lakṣya māma vyadhikaraṇa tvam aśakyasya bāhīkasya go śabdena pratipādana asambhavaḥ ca tat āhuḥ lakṣyamāṇa guṇaiḥ yogāt vṛtteḥ iṣṭā tu gauṇa tā iti

original: lakṣamāṇā ye jāḍyādayastaireva yadi śakyasambandhastadā gauṇī vṛttirityartha iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: lakṣamāṇāḥ ye jāḍya ādayaḥ taiḥ eva yadi śakya sambandhaḥ tadā gauṇī vṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: grāmo dagdha iti| avayavadharmāṇāṃ samudāye'trāropa iti na yuktam| dagdhapadasyaiva dagdhagṛhavādvācakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| jahadajahaditi| dagdhasya tadvataśca bodhāt||1.38||

original: svajñāpyasambandho lakṣaṇā | bhavati ca vākyārtho'pi vākyajñānapyastena vākyasya lakṣaṇeti mīmāṃsakamatenāha| jñāpyeti| gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāmiti vākyaspa bodhyo gabhīrābhinnānadī tatsambandhastīra iti bhāvaḥ| na hi tīraṃ nadīti| gabhīratīre nadyāmityarthāsambhavāt| na nadīpade'pīti| nadīpadena nadītīragrahaṇe gabhīrasāmānādhikaraṇpāsambhava ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sva jñāpya sambandhaḥ lakṣaṇā bhavati ca vākya arthaḥ api vākya jñāna pyaḥ tena vākyasya lakṣaṇā iti mīmāṃsaka matena āha jñāpya iti gabhīrāyām nadyām iti bodhyaḥ gabhīra abhinnā nadī tad sambandhaḥ tīre iti bhāvaḥ na hi tīram nadī iti gabhīra tīre nadyām iti artha asambhavāt na nadī pade ipi iti nadī padena nadī tīra grahaṇe gabhīra sāmānādhikaraṇya asambhavaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: padadvaye| gabhīrapade nadīpade ca | pranyekamiti| gabhīrapadasya gabhīratīre nadīpadasya nadītīre ityarthaḥ| viśiṣṭeti| gabhīranadītīrabodhānāpatterityarthaḥ| yattu gabhīrapadaṃ nadīpadaṃ cetyubhayamapi gabhīranadītīralakṣakaṃ tatraikapadārthabodhe 'paradaṃ tātparyagrāhakamiti tanna| evamapi samudāyaśaktau paryavasāne tasyā eva nyāyyatvāt|
analyzed: pada dvaye gabhīra pade nadī pade ca iti gabhīra padasya gabhīra tīre nadī padasya nadī tīre iti arthaḥ viśiṣṭā iti gabhīra nadī tīra bodha anāpatteḥ iti arthaḥ yat tu gabhīra padam nadī padam ca iti ubhayam api gabhīra nadī tīra lakṣakam tatra eka padārtha bodhe para dam tātparya grāhakam iti tat na evam api samudāya śaktau paryavasāne tasyāḥ eva nyāyya tvāt

original: vinigamanāvirahāditi| gabhīrapadasyaiva lakṣpaṇāstvityarthaḥ| gabhīratvaviśiṣṭanadīsaṃyuktatvasya sambandhatve gauravāllāghavānnadīpadameva lakṣakamiti yuktam| gabhīrapadaṃ gabhīratvaguṇe śaktamityāśayena śaṅkate| na ceti| guṇīti | śuklādiśabdevat| ata eva| samudāye lakṣamāsvīkārādeva| arthavādavākyānāmiti|
analyzed: vinigamanā virahāt iti gabhīra padasya eva lakṣpaṇā astu iti arthaḥ gabhīra tva viśiṣṭa nadī saṃyukta tvasya sambandha tve gauravāt lāghavāt nadī padam eva lakṣakam iti yuktam gabhīra padam gabhīra tva guṇe śaktam iti āśayena śaṅkate na ca iti guṇī iti śukla ādi śabda vat atas eva samudāye lakṣamā svīkārāt eva arthavāda vākyānām iti

original: arthasya prayojanasya vadanaṃ vidhyarthapraśaṃsāparaṃ vacanam| vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā iti vākyasya vāyudevatākaṃ karma praśastamityarthalakṣakatvāt| pare tu sarvatra viśeṣyapadasyaiva lakṣaṇā itarapadānāṃ tātparyagrāha katvācca vākyalakṣaṇāpravāda ityāhustanna|
analyzed: arthasya prayojanasya vadanam vidhi artha praśaṃsā param vacanam vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhāḥ devatāḥ iti vākyasya vāyu devatākam karma praśastam iti artha lakṣaka tvāt pare tu sarvatra viśeṣya padasya eva lakṣaṇā itara padānām tātparya grāha ka tvāt ca vākya lakṣaṇā pravādaḥ iti āhuḥ tat na

original: prathamata eva gavābhedabodhe tvityarthaḥ| tasmin| gavābhedajñāne | bhramatvajñānāditi| gavābhedajñānasya bhramātmakattvānna camatkāra ityarthaḥ| ata eva |āropitatvapratyayādeva| gośabdasya tatsadṛśajatvādiparatve tu paunaruktyāpattirityarthaḥ|ṣa nanu gotvārope lakṣyamāṇaguṇairyogāditi pravādāsaṅgatirata āha| lakṣyamāṇeti|
analyzed: prathamatas eva gavā abheda bodhe tu iti arthaḥ tasmin gavā abheda jñāne bhrama tva jñānāt iti gavā abheda jñānasya bhrama ātmaka ttvāt na camatkāraḥ iti arthaḥ atas eva āropita tva pratyayāt eva go śabdasya tad sadṛśa ja tva ādi paratve tu paunaruktya āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu go tva ārope lakṣyamāṇa guṇaiḥ yogāt iti pravāda asaṅgatiḥ atas āha lakṣyamāṇa iti

original: tathācāropahetubhūtatvena jñāyamānaguṇairyogādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ācāra upahetu bhūta tvena jñāyamāna guṇaiḥ yogāt iti arthaḥ

original: gavabhinno bāhīka iti bodhe'tijaḍatvapratītyā camatkārātiśaya ityabhipretyāha| yadveti| nanu lakṣaṇātaḥ prāk kathamabheda bodhastasya bādhitatvenāpraṇyāpatterata āha| bādhajñānasyeti| anupapattijeti| anupapattijā yā lakṣaṇā tajjanyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: go abhinnaḥ bāhīkaḥ iti bodha iti jaḍa tva pratītyā camatkāra atiśayaḥ iti abhipretya āha yat vā iti nanu lakṣaṇātaḥ prāk katham abheda bodhaḥ tasya bādhita tvena apraṇyāpatteḥ atas āha bādha jñānasya iti anupapatti jā iti anupapatti jā yā lakṣaṇā tad janyā iti arthaḥ

original: vastutastu bādhajñānaṃ na pratibandhakaṃ na vā tadabhāvakāraṇaṃ bādhasthale viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakārakaniścayābhāvādeva viśi,ṭabuddhyanutpatteḥ| nyāyavārtiketi| uktānuktaduruktacitnatākaraṃvākyaṃ vartikam| nanūpaniṣadvārtikānāṃ kathaṃ durukticintākaratvaṃ tatra duruktābhāvāt, satyam| tatrāpiduruktatvabhrāntisambhavāt|
analyzed: vastutas tu bādha jñānam na pratibandhakam na vā tad abhāva kāraṇam bādha sthale viśeṣaṇa tā avacchedaka prakāraka niścaya abhāvāt eva viśiṣṭa buddhi anutpatteḥ nyāyavārtika iti ukta anukta durukta citnatā karam vākyam vartikam nanu upaniṣad vārtikānām katham durukti cintā kara tvam tatra durukta abhāvāt satyam tatra api durukta tva bhrānti sambhavāt

original: nanu sāmānādhikaraṇyarūpasāhacaryasya yaṣṭitaddhārimorasambhava ityata āha| sāhacaryaṃ nāmeti| sambandhāttviti| yaṣṭi kāsambandhādyaṣṭikāśabdaprayoge tvityarthaḥ|

original: vrīhīnprokṣatītyādāvapūrvasādhananīvāreṣu vrīhitvamāropyata iti pratipādayitumāha| vrīhīnprokṣatīti| ayambhāvaḥ| keṣāṃ citsāhacaryeṇa jātiḥ śaktupalakṣaṇamiti haryuktarītyā vrīhitvajātyupalakṣitā śaktireva kriyāsādhanatvenāpadiśyate| evañca jātikriyayoreva vibhaktiprāpitaḥ śrautaḥ sambandhaḥ nirāśrayāyāśca jāterabhāvād‌dravyamākṣipyate|
analyzed: vrīhīn prokṣati ityādau apūrva sādhana nīvāreṣu vrīhi tvam āropyate iti pratipādayitum āha vrīhīn prokṣati iti ayam bhāvaḥ keṣām cit sāhacaryeṇa jātiḥ śaktu alakṣaṇam iti hari ukta rītyā vrīhi tva jāti upalakṣitā śaktiḥ eva kriyā sādhanatvena apadiśyate evam ca jāti kriyayoḥ eva vibhakti prāpitaḥ śrautaḥ sambandhaḥ nirāśrayāyāḥ ca jāteḥ abhāvāt dravyam ākṣipyate

original: tathā ca nīvāreṣu sadṛśatvād‌vrīhitvajāterapāyāt siddhaṃ pratinidheḥ śrautatvam| etacca jātipakṣe eva sambhavati| vyaktiyakṣe tu sākṣād‌dravyasyaiva kriyāsādhanatvena pradhānatvāttattyāge pratinidhyuccheda eva syāditi| apūrveti| etena īpsitatame karmaṇi vrīhīniti dvitīyāvidhānātpradhānasyaṃ pratinidhyamasbhava ityapāstham|
analyzed: tathā ca nīvāreṣu sadṛśa tvāt vrīhi tva jāteḥ apāyāt siddham pratinidheḥ śrauta tvam etat ca jāti pakṣe eva sambhavati vyakti yakṣe tu sākṣāt dravyasya eva kriyā sādhana tvena pradhāna tvāt tad tyāge pratinidhi ucchedaḥ eva syāt iti apūrvā iti etena īpsitatame karmaṇi vrīhīn iti dvitīyā vidhānāt pradhānasyam iti apāstham

original: atra prokṣaṇādeḥ pradhānāṅgatvenādṛṣṭadvārā pradhānāpūrvaphalatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ na tu vrīhiphalārthatvam| ata eva kṛṣṇaleṣu vituṣībhāvarūpadvāralopanādavāghātanivṛttāvapi prokṣaṇam| vīhitvenaiveti| tena vrīhyabhāve nīvārāṇāṃ grahaṇam| prakṛtāpūrvasādhanatvānnīvārāṇāṃ grahaṇamiti mataṃ nirākaroti| na tvapūrveti| anyathā yavānāmapi prokṣaṇaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: atra prokṣaṇa ādeḥ pradhāna aṅga tvena adṛṣṭa dvārā pradhāna apūrva phalatvam nyāyyam na tu vrīhi phala arthatvam atas eva kṛṣṇaleṣu vituṣībhāva rūpa dvāra lopanāt avāghāta nivṛttau api prokṣaṇam vīhi tvena eva iti tena vrīhi abhāve nīvārāṇām grahaṇam prakṛta apūrva sādhana tvāt nīvārāṇām grahaṇam iti matam nirākaroti na tu apūrvā iti anyathā yavānām api prokṣaṇa prasaṅgaḥ

original: nanu pravṛttinimitārope 'nekārthatvābhāvātsaṃyogādinā viśeṣasmṛtiriti pūrvoktagranthāsaṅgatirityataḥ prathamaṃ tatraiva sammapiṃ darśayati| ekamāhuriti| sarveṣāmarthānāṃ gośabda eka eva vācakaḥ| arthaprakāraṇāṃbhyāṃ śabdāntareṇa yogādvā ekamevārthaṃ prakāśayanti na sarvārtham| nimittabhedāt prasiddhyaprasiddhivaśāt|
analyzed: nanu pravṛtti nimita ārope na eka artha tva abhāvāt saṃyoga ādinā viśeṣa smṛtiḥ iti pūrva ukta grantha asaṅgatiḥ iti atas prathamam tatra eva sammapim darśayati ekam āhuḥ iti sarveṣām arthānām go śabdaḥ ekaḥ eva vācakaḥ artha prakāra śabda antareṇa yogāt vā ekam eva artham prakāśayanti na sarva artham nimitta bhedāt prasiddhi aprasiddhi vaśāt

original: sarvārthatvaṃ bhidyate nānāvidhaṃ bhavati| kvacidrauṇaṃ kvacinmukhyam| yadyapi gośabdaḥ sāsnādimantamiva bāhīkamapyabhidadhāti tathāpi bāhīke aprasiddhatvādrauṇaḥ|
analyzed: sarva artha tvam bhidyate nānāvidham bhavati kvacid rauṇam kvacid mukhyam yadi api go śabdaḥ sāsnādimantam iva bāhīkam api abhidadhāti tathā api bāhīke aprasiddha tvāt rauṇaḥ

original: idānīṃ pravṛttinimittāropapakṣe sammatiṃ darśayitumupakramate| nanvevamiti| gośabdasya bāhīke ārope śabdārthasambandhasyānityātvāpattirityarthaḥ| viparyastam| bhinnādhikaraṇeṣvāropitaṃ gotvameva sarvatrārthaḥ| tasyaiva tu bheda ityāha| gaurityatreti| artho dvividhaḥ gotvādi svarūpañca| tatrādyaṃ vyākhyāya dvitīyamāha| śabda eveti| saḥ| śabdaḥ|
analyzed: idānīm pravṛtti nimitta āropa pakṣe sammatim darśayitum upakramate nanu evam iti go śabdasya bāhīke ārope śabda artha sambandhasya anitya tva āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ viparyastam bhinna adhikaraṇeṣu āropitam go tvam eva sarvatra arthaḥ tasya eva tu bhedaḥ iti āha gauḥ iti atra iti arthaḥ dvividhaḥ go tva ādi svarūpam ca tatra ādyam vyākhyāya dvitīyam āha śabdaḥ eva iti saḥ śabdaḥ

original: anuṣajyate| viniyujyate| nanvarthaviparyāse nānārthatvaṃ durvāramata āha| artho 'treti| tathā ca viśeṣyasya bhede'pi pravṛttinimittasya na bheda iti bhāvaḥ| nanu jaḍo bāhīka ityeva prayujyatāṃ kiṃ gaurvāḍika iti prayogemetyata āha| lakṣaṇāphalaṃ tviti| lākṣaṇikaśabdaprayogaphalaṃ tvityarthaḥ| sādṛśyapratītiḥ| atijaḍatvapratītiḥ| mukhyārtheti|
analyzed: anuṣajyate viniyujyate nanu artha viparyāse nānārthatvam durvāram atas āha tathā ca viśeṣyasya bhede api pravṛtti nimittasya na bhedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu jaḍaḥ bāhīkaḥ iti eva prayujyatām kim gauḥ vāḍikaḥ iti prayogema iti atas āha lakṣaṇā phalam tu iti lākṣaṇika śabda prayoga phalam tu iti arthaḥ sādṛśya pratītiḥ ati jaḍa tva pratītiḥ mukhya artha iti

original: murūyārthasya yaḥ sākṣātsambandhastanmūlakāropāpekṣayetyarthaḥ| gauṇyāmeveti| na caivaṃ gauṇyā lakṣitalakṣaṇātvāpittiḥ|lakṣitalakṣaṇāyā granthakṛtaiva nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt| lakṣaṇayaiva śaityapāvanatvādīnāṃ pratīterna vyañjanāvṛttyantaramiti tārkikamataṃ nirākurvatāṃ prakāśakārādīnāṃ sammatiṃ darśayati| prayojanaṃ na lakṣyamiti|
analyzed: yaḥ sākṣāt sambandhaḥ tad mūlaka āropa apekṣayā iti arthaḥ gauṇyām eva iti na ca evam gauṇyāḥ lakṣita lakṣaṇā tva āpittiḥ lakṣita lakṣaṇāyāḥ granthakṛtā eva nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt lakṣaṇayā eva śaitya pāvana tva ādīnām pratīteḥ na vyañjana āvṛtti antaram iti tārkika matam nirākurvatām prakāśakāra ādīnām sammatim darśayati prayojanam na lakṣyam iti

original: śaityapāvantavādau śakyasambandhābhāvāllaṇā na sabhbhavatītyarthaḥ|| 1.43 ||
analyzed: na

original: nanu gavādipadānāṃ vyañjanayā jāḍyādiparatve prakāre guṇavacanasyeti dvitvāpattiḥ | prakāraḥ sādṛśyam| sādṛśye vartamānaḥ san yo guṇavacana ityarthādityāśaṅkyāha| prāgguṇavacananatveti| ayambhāvaḥ| guṇavacanaḥ san yaḥ prakāre vartate tasya dvitvamityarthaḥ| yathā paṭurityasya paṭusadṛśa ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu go ādi padānām vyañjanayā jāḍya ādi paratve prakāre guṇavacanasya iti dvi tva āpattiḥ prakāraḥ sādṛśyam sādṛśye vartamānaḥ san yaḥ guṇa vacanaḥ iti arthāt iti āśaṅkya āha prāk guṇa vacana natva iti ayam bhāvaḥ guṇa vacanaḥ san yaḥ prakāre vartate tasya dvi tvam iti arthaḥ yathā paṭuḥ iti asya paṭu sadṛśaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ityevaṃ rītyaiva bhāṣyaśaṅkottare yojyete na tu gośabdasya sādṛśyalakṣakatvena guṇavacanatvaṃ sādṛśyanimittakābhedopacārādropaśabdo gopyāṃ vartata iti puṃyogāditi sūtrasthabhāṣyabirodhāditi bhāvaḥ| gaṅgādibhiḥ| sāmīpya iti| satīti śeṣaḥ | gautamokta iti| sahacaraṇasthānetyādinā gauttamenāpi dharmāropa ukta ityarthaḥ| patañjalyukta iti|
analyzed: iti evam rītyā eva bhāṣya śaṅkā uttare yojyete na tu go śabdasya sādṛśya lakṣaka tvena guṇa vacana tvam sādṛśya nimittaka abheda upacārāt ropa śabdaḥ gopyām vartate iti pum yogāt iti sūtra stha bhāṣya birodhāt iti bhāvaḥ gaṅgā ādibhiḥ sāmīpye iti sati iti śeṣaḥ gautama uktaḥ iti sahacaraṇa sthāna ityādinā gauttamena api dharma āropaḥ uktaḥ iti arthaḥ patañjali uktaḥ iti

original: caturbhiḥ prakārairityupakramya sāmīpyād‌gaṅgāśabdo vartata iti prāguktatvāt| ādyo 'pīti| sādhakatamiti tamap grahaṇena gauṇādhārasyāpi grahaṇajñānādyatrātyantasāmīpyātpravāhe ghoṣādhikaraṇatvāropastatra saptamī siddheti bhāṣyam| nanu gargā ityādau gargāpatye gargaśabdaśya kathaṃ sādhutvaṃ pūrvoktaprakārāmaāmabhāvādata āha| yatra tviti|
analyzed: caturbhiḥ prakāraiḥ iti upakramya sāmīpyāt gaṅgā śabdaḥ vartate iti prāgukta tvāt pi iti tamap grahaṇena gauṇa ādhārasya api grahaṇa jñānāt yatra atyanta sāmīpyāt pravāhe ghoṣa adhikaraṇa tva āropaḥ tatra saptamī siddhā iti bhāṣyam nanu gargāḥ ityādau garga apatye garga śabda katham sādhu tvam yatra tu iti

original: śāstre kvacitprakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayenābhidhīyata iti haryukteḥ| evaṃ nakṣatre ca lupīti sūtramapi ukte 'rthe mānam| rathantaraṃ sāma abhitvā śūra nonuma ityasyāṃ gītam| lakṣaṇetyayuktamiti| bādhapratisandhānaṃ vināpi bodhāllakṣaṇā na yuktetyarthaḥ| tārkikaikadeśino lakṣitalakṣaṇā vṛttyantaramityāhuḥ|
analyzed: śāstre kvacid prakṛti arthaḥ pratyayena abhidhīyate iti haryukteḥ evam nakṣatre ca lupi iti sūtram api ukte rthe mānam rathantaram sāma abhitvā śūra nonumaḥ iti asyām gītam lakṣaṇā iti ayuktam iti bādha pratisandhānam vinā api bodhāt lakṣaṇā na yuktā iti arthaḥ tārkika ekadeśinaḥ lakṣita lakṣaṇā vṛtti antaram iti āhuḥ

original: tathā hi dvirephapade rephapadasya rephadvayasambandhini bhramarapade lakṣaṇā bhramarapadasya ca bhramare iti tānnirākaroti lakṣitalakṣaṇeti| nanu dvirephapadalakṣitena bhramarapedena śaktyaiva bhramarabodhāllakṣaṇāvyarthe ti cenna| dvirephapadavṛttyabhāve pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyārthanviteti nyāyavirodhāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi dvirepha pade repha padasya repha dvaya sambandhini bhramara pade lakṣaṇā bhramara padasya ca bhramare iti tān nirākaroti lakṣita lakṣaṇā iti nanu dvirepha pada lakṣitena bhramara pedena śaktyā eva bhramara bodhāt lakṣaṇā avyarthe ti ced na dvirepha pada vṛtti abhāve pratyayānām prakṛtyā artha nvitā iti nyāya virodha āpatteḥ

original: evañja dvirephapadasyaiva lakṣitalakṣaṇāvṛttiḥ| tathā ca lakṣitasya lakṣaṇeti śabdārthaḥ| pare tu śakyasambandha eva lakṣaṇā na tu śakyasya sākṣātsambandho lakṣaṇā gauravāt| tathā ca paramparāsambandhena bhramāropasthāpakatvāddhvirephapadasya bhramare vṛttiḥ| tathā ca lakṣitapadaghaṭitalakṣaṇā lakṣitalakṣaṇātyartha ityāhuḥ|
analyzed: evañja dvirepha padasya eva lakṣita lakṣaṇā vṛttiḥ tathā ca lakṣitasya lakṣaṇā iti śabda arthaḥ pare tu śakya sambandhe eva lakṣaṇā na tu śakyasya sākṣāt sambandhaḥ lakṣaṇā gauravāt tathā ca paramparā sambandhena bhramāra upasthāpaka tvāt hvirepha padasya bhramare vṛttiḥ tathā ca lakṣita pada ghaṭita lakṣaṇā lakṣita lakṣaṇā atyarthaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: nanu pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānviteti nyāyavirodho 'ta āha| prakṛtiprayojyeti| jata iti| yajñakarmaṇyajapanyūṅkasāmasvitveśrutiniṣedhāt| vastutastu adṛṣṭārthaśabdoccāraṇamātraṃ japa iti yajñaviṣaye pāribhāṣiko bhinna eva japaśabdaḥ | traisvaryeṇeti| yathāprāptaistribhirapi svarairityarthaḥ| manasoccāryeti|
analyzed: nanu pratyayānām prakṛti artha anvitā iti nyāya virodhaḥ te āha prakṛti prayojyā iti jataḥ iti vastutas tu adṛṣṭa artha śabda uccāraṇa mātram japaḥ iti yajña viṣaye pāribhāṣikaḥ bhinnaḥ eva japa śabdaḥ traisvaryeṇa iti yathāprāptaiḥ tribhiḥ api svaraiḥ iti arthaḥ manasā uccārya iti

original: satkāryavāde kāryakāraṇayorabhedabuddhisthatvena rūpeṇa prakṛtitvaṃ vāhyarūpeṇa vikṛtitvaṃ tathehāpi syaṣṭamiti kārthavipariṇāmāditi tatra samāhitatvāt | kāryā buddhiḥ tasyā vipariṇāma ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: satkārya vāde kārya kāraṇayoḥ abheda buddhi stha tvena rūpeṇa prakṛti tvam vāhya rūpeṇa vikṛti tvam tathā iha api syaṣṭam iti kārtha vipariṇāmāt iti tatra samāhita tvāt kāryā buddhiḥ tasyāḥ vipariṇāmaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ayaṃ ca śabda iti| dhvanivyaṅgatayā vācakatvena svīkṛta ityarthaḥ| samaṣṭeriti| vanamityākārikā ekatābuddhiḥ samaṣṭiḥ māyādibhuvanāntavirāṭ‌puruṣasya śarīraṃ sthūladehasamaṣṭyā virāḍucyate virājo hṛdayadeśa eva hyakāśa ucyata ityarthaḥ| deśasthāśceti| vyāpakatvādubhayadeśasya ityarthaḥ| saceti| śabdaścetyarthaḥ| yathaikatreti|
analyzed: ayam ca śabdaḥ iti dhvani vyaṅgatayā vācaka tvena svīkṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ samaṣṭeḥ iti vanam iti ākārikā ekatā buddhiḥ samaṣṭiḥ māyā ādi bhuvana anta virāj puruṣasya śarīram sthūla deha samaṣṭyā virāj ucyate virājaḥ hṛdaya deśaḥ eva hi akāśaḥ ucyate iti arthaḥ deśa sthāḥ ca iti vyāpaka tvāt ubhaya deśasya iti arthaḥ sacā iti śabdaḥ ca iti arthaḥ yathā ekatra iti

original: yatra tu bhinnāvayāvāvacchedena rūpabhedastatra rūpamavyāpyavṛttyeveti bhāvaḥ| etena tadarthaṃ citrarūpasvī kāro'pāstaḥ|
analyzed: yatra tu bhinna avayāva avacchedena rūpa bhedaḥ tatra rūpam avyāpya vṛttyā iva iti bhāvaḥ etena tad artham citra rūpa svī kāra upāstaḥ

original: lohito yastu varṇena mukhe pucche ca pāṇḍuraḥ|
analyzed: lohitaḥ yaḥ tu varṇena mukhe pucche ca pāṇḍuraḥ

original: iti smṛtivirodhāt | kiñcaivaṃ surabhyasurabhikapālārabdhaghaṭasya nirgandhatvameva vācyam| tathā ca gandhamprati pṛthivītvena hetutvasya vyabhicāraḥ| tatheti| rūpādivacchabdasyāpi vyāpyavṛttitvaṃ nyāyyam| yathā hi vyāpakasyāpi rūpasya cakṣussaṃyogaptamānādhikaraṇsyaiva pratyakṣamevaṃ deśāntare śabdapratyakṣateti bhāvaḥ| indraśabda iti|
analyzed: iti smṛti virodhāt kiñca evam surabhi asurabhi kapāla ārabdha ghaṭasya nirgandha tvam eva vācyam tathā ca gandham prati pṛthivī tvena hetu tvasya vyabhicāraḥ tathā iti rūpa ādi vat śabdasya api vyāpya vṛtti tvam nyāyyam yathā hi vyāpakasya api rūpasya pratyakṣam evam deśa antare śabda pratyakṣa tā iti bhāvaḥ indra śabdaḥ iti

original: mīmāṃsakaścaivaturthyantarthyantaśabdātiriktayā devatāyā asvīkārāt| śābdikamate'pi śabdarthayorabhedāddevatārūpatvaṃ mantrasya vigrahavattvaṃ svīkṛtya tu devatānāṃ karmānadhikāra ukta uttaramīmāṃsāyāṃ śabdānāmarthaparatvasyautsargikatvātprayogasamavotārthasmṛtāveva tātparyaṃ nājñātadevatāvigrahādāvapīti tu mantrādhikaraṇasyāśayaḥ | bhāṣyāditi|
analyzed: mīmāṃsakaḥ ca eva turthī antarthī anta śabda atiriktayā devatāyāḥ asvīkārāt śābdika mate pi śabda arthayoḥ abhedāt devatā rūpatvam mantrasya vigrahavattvam svīkṛtya tu devatānām karma anadhikāraḥ uktaḥ uttara mīmāṃsāyām śabdānām artha paratvasya autsargika tvāt prayoga samavota artha smṛtau eva tātparyam na ajñāta devatā vigraha ādau api iti tu mantra adhikaraṇasya āśayaḥ bhāṣyāt iti

original: jātīreva śabdārtha ityupakramya eka evendraśabdaḥ sarveṣu yāgeṣūpakarotītyuktatvāt| etacca śabdasya vyāpakatvaṃ eva yujyate| katvādineti| dhvanigatakatvādestavārāpāt| padārūpeṇeti| pade varṇābhāvād‌buddhiparikalpatapadatvamiti bhāvaḥ| bhāṣye kathamidaṃ spaṣṭamata āha| tattara hīti| śrotropalabdhiriti| śrotro evopalabdhiryasyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: jātīḥ eva śabda arthaḥ iti upakramya ekaḥ eva indra śabdaḥ sarveṣu yāgeṣu upakaroti iti ukta tvāt etat ca śabdasya vyāpaka tvam eva yujyate ka tva ādinā iti dhvani gata ka tva ādeḥ tavārāpāt pada ārūpeṇa iti pade varṇa abhāvāt buddhi parikalpa tapadatvam iti bhāvaḥ bhāṣye katham idam spaṣṭam atas āha tat tara hi iti śrotra upalabdhiḥ iti śrotram eva upalabdhiḥ yasya iti arthaḥ

original: śrotropalabdhyā ca śabdasyākādeśatvaṃ pratipāditam| karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnanabhasa eva śrotratvādākāśadiśo nātiriktatvamityābhiprāyeṇa deśaśabdaprayoga ākāśe bodhyaḥ| yadi tu śaṅkhādīnāmeva guṇaḥ|
analyzed: śrotra upalabdhyā ca śabdasya ākā deśa tvam pratipāditam karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinna nabhasaḥ eva śrotra tvāt ākāśa diśaḥ na atirikta tvam ityā abhiprāyeṇa deśa śabda prayogaḥ ākāśe bodhyaḥ yadi tu śaṅkha ādīnām eva guṇaḥ

original: syāttadāniṣṭakriyasya śabdasya śrotraparyantaṃ gamanaṃ na sambhavati śrotrasya vā tatparyantaṃ gamanaṃ na sambhavatīti śrotrasambandhābhāvātpratyakṣaṃ na syāt| bhāṣyasthaviśeṣaṇatrayeṇa rūpatrayaṃ darśayati| tatretyādinā| tārkikamataṃ dūṣayati| anyatheti|
analyzed: syāt tadā aniṣṭa kriyasya śabdasya śrotra paryantam gamanam na sambhavati śrotrasya vā tad paryantam gamanam na sambhavati iti śrotra sambandha abhāvāt pratyakṣam na syāt bhāṣya stha viśeṣaṇa trayeṇa rūpa trayam darśayati tatra ityādinā tārkika matam dūṣayati anyathā iti

original: kadambapuṣpavat daśadik‌sañcāriṇo daśa śabdā utpadyante te ca śrotreṇa sambaddhā gṛhyanta ityarthaḥ| ādinā vīcītaraṅganyāyaḥ | tadyathā vīciḥ prathamamutpannā vīcyantaraṃ janayati evaṃ śabdo 'pyādyaḥ śabdāntaraṃ janayati, tadapi śabdāntamityevaṃ śrotrasambandho bhavati| tatpratyakṣānupapattyeti| ādyaśabdasya śrotrasambandhāmāvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kadamba puṣpa vat daśa diś sañcāriṇaḥ daśa śabdāḥ utpadyante te ca śrotreṇa sambaddhāḥ gṛhyante iti arthaḥ ādinā vīcī taraṅga nyāyaḥ tat yathā vīciḥ prathamam utpannā vīci antaram janayati evam śabdaḥ u pi ādyaḥ śabda antaram janayati tat api śabda antam iti evam śrotra sambandhaḥ bhavati tad pratyakṣa anupapattyā iti ādya śabdasya śrotra sambandha amāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ekaśabdetve atidūrasthasyāpi pratyakṣāpattirata āha| tatreti| yathā tārkikamate atidūraparyantaṃ na śabdotpattistathāsmānmate 'bhivyāktirapi netyarthaḥ| ata eva | śabdasya vyāpakatvādeva | svaṃ śrotraṃ tena śrotreṇa|| 1.52 ||
analyzed: nanu eka śabda tve ati dūra sthasya api pratyakṣa āpattiḥ atas āha tatra iti yathā tārkika mate ati dūra paryantam na śabda utpattiḥ tathā asmānmate bhivyāktiḥ api na iti arthaḥ atas eva śabdasya vyāpaka tvāt eva svam śrotram tena śrotreṇa

original: śabdāśrayatayātiriktaṃdravyamākāśamiti tārkikamataṃ nirākaroti | na ceti| asiddherityatra hetumāhāsparśeti | sparśavataḥ pṛthivyādicatuṣṭayasya viśeṣo vāyustasya guṇaḥ śabda ityarthaḥ| pṛthivyāmanuṣṇāśītasparśasvīkārastu tvācapratyakṣe sparśasya hetutvānurodhāt| atra vaiśeṣikāḥ | śabdo na sparśavato viśeṣaguṇaḥ.
analyzed: śabda āśraya tayā atiriktam dravyam ākāśam iti tārkika matam nirākaroti na ca iti asiddheḥ iti atra hetum āha asparśa iti sparśavataḥ pṛthivī ādi catuṣṭayasya viśeṣaḥ vāyuḥ tasya guṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti arthaḥ pṛthivyām anuṣṇa aśīta sparśa svīkāraḥ tu tvāca pratyakṣe sparśasya hetu tva anurodhāt atra vaiśeṣikāḥ śabdaḥ na sparśavataḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ

original: agnisaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇaktavābhāve satyākāraṇagupūrvakakatvāt, yo hi pṛthivyāderguṇaḥ so'gnisaṃyogajanyaḥ , athavā samavāyikāraṇaguṇapūrvakaḥ na ca śabdastathā| nāpi vāyuguṇaḥ āśrayanāśajanyanāśrapratiyogatitvābhāvāditi vadanti| tānnirākaroti| na cāyāvad‌dravyeti|
analyzed: agni saṃyoga asamavāyi kāraṇa ktava abhāve sati akāraṇa gu pūrvakaka tvāt yaḥ hi pṛthivī ādeḥ guṇaḥ saḥ ugni saṃyoga janyaḥ athavā samavāyi kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakaḥ na ca śabdaḥ tathā nā api vāyu guṇaḥ vadanti tān nirākaroti na ca ayāvaddravya iti

original: sakaladravyam, tathāca pṛthivyādiguṇasya svāśrayamātravṛttitayānyatra pratyakṣānāpattirityarthaḥ| tādṛśeti| guṇiniṣṭhatvameva pṛthivyādiguṇasyeti niyama ityarthaḥ| anaṅgīkārāditi| puṣpasaurabhasya vāyunānayanadarśanāt| na ca tatra puṣpāvayavo 'pyāyātīti vācyam| puṣpasya laghutvāpatteḥ| āśrayāt| vāyoḥ | anyatra| ākāśe|
analyzed: sakala dravyam tathā ca pṛthivī ādi guṇasya sva āśraya mātra vṛttitayā anyatra pratyakṣa anāpattiḥ iti arthaḥ tādṛśa iti guṇi niṣṭhatvam eva pṛthivī ādi guṇasya iti niyamaḥ iti arthaḥ anaṅgīkārāt iti puṣpa saurabhasya vāyunā ānayana darśanāt na ca tatra puṣpa avayavaḥ pyāyāti iti vācyam puṣpasya laghu tva āpatteḥ āśrayāt vāyoḥ anyatra ākāśe

original: yāvad‌dravyabhāvitvamiti hi tārkikāṇāṃ prasiddhistataścāśrayādanyatretyakṣarāsvārasyam| bhāṣyasthaviśaṣaṇatrayeṇa rūpatrayaṃ darśayati| kadambapuṣpavaddaśadik‌sañcāriṇo daśa śabdā utpadyante te ca śrotreṇa sambaddhā gṛhyanta ityarthaḥ| ādinā nīcītaraṅganyāyaḥ|
analyzed: yāvaddravyabhāvitvam iti hi tārkikāṇām prasiddhiḥ tatas ca āśrayāt anyatra iti akṣara asvārasyam bhāṣya stha viśaṣaṇa trayeṇa rūpa trayam darśayati kadamba puṣpa vat daśa diś sañcāriṇaḥ daśa śabdāḥ utpadyante te ca śrotreṇa sambaddhāḥ gṛhyante iti arthaḥ ādinā nīcītaraṅga nyāyaḥ

original: tadyathā vīciḥ prathamamutpannā vīcyantaraṃ janayatyevaṃ śabdo 'pyādyaḥ śabdāntaraṃ janayati tadapiśabdāntaramityevaṃ śrotrasambandho bhavati tatpratyakṣānupapattyetyādyaśabdasya śrotrasambandhābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvekaśabdatve 'tidūrasthasyāpi pratyakṣāpattirata āha|tatreti|
analyzed: tat yathā vīciḥ prathamam utpannā vīci antaram janayati evam śabdaḥ u pi ādyaḥ śabda antaram janayati tat api śabda antaram iti evam śrotra sambandhaḥ bhavati tad pratyakṣa anupapattyā iti ādya śabdasya śrotra sambandha abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu eka śabda tve ti dūra sthasya api pratyakṣa āpattiḥ atas āha tatra iti

original: yathā tārkikamate 'tidūraraparyantaṃ na śabdotpattistathāsamanmate 'bhivyaktirapi netyarthaḥ| tavāpīti| deśāntare utpannasya śabdasyā deśāntare utpannasya śabdasya deśāntare 'pyupalambhāttārrkikāṇāmapi guṇamātrāniṣṭhatvaniyamo netyarthaḥ| dravyagrāhaketi|
analyzed: yathā tārkika mate na śabda utpattiḥ tathā asamat mate abhivyaktiḥ api na iti arthaḥ tava api iti deśa antare utpannasya śabdasya ā deśa antare utpannasya śabdasya deśa antare pi upalambhāt tārrkikāṇām api guṇa mātrā niṣṭha tva niyamaḥ na iti arthaḥ dravya grāhaka iti

original: cakṣuṣā ghaṭagrahaṇānantaraṃ saṃyuktasamavāyeva tadraguṇapratyakṣād‌guṇinoḥ samānendiyagrāhyatvamevetyarthaḥ| svavāsaneti| śrotreṇākāśasyāgrahaṇe'pi tadguṇasya śabdasya grahaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| ākāśadeśa iti| ākāśadeśāvacchedetyarthaḥ| ādhāraśaktiriti| asya pūrvārdhaṃ tu|
analyzed: cakṣuṣā ghaṭa grahaṇa anantaram saṃyukta samavāyā iva samāna indiya grāhya tvam eva iti arthaḥ sva vāsanā iti śrotreṇa ākāśasya agrahaṇe api tad guṇasya śabdasya grahaṇāt iti bhāvaḥ ākāśa deśaḥ iti ākāśa deśa avaccheda iti arthaḥ ādhāra śaktiḥ iti asya pūrva ardham tu

original: ākāśameva keṣāṃ ciddeśabhedaprakalpanāt|
analyzed: ākāśam eva keṣām cit deśa bheda prakalpanāt

original: iti| keṣāṃ saṃyogibhedenākāśasya nānātvādākāśamevāvādhikaraṇamityarthaḥ| sarvasaṃyogināmiti| ayambhāvaḥ| yathā nakṣatrādīmadhikaraṇamākāśaṃ tathā pṛthivyadisthānāṃ rathādīnāmapi mukhyādhikaraṇamākāśaṃ, samavāyināṃ tu svāśrayadvārā paramāṇau viśrāmaḥ, paramāṇūnāṃ cākaśamevādhikaraṇamityamākāśaḥ sarveṣāmādhāraśaktimān|
analyzed: iti keṣām saṃyogi bhedena ākāśasya nānātvāt ākāśam eva adhikaraṇam iti arthaḥ sarva saṃyoginām iti ayam bhāvaḥ yathā nakṣatra ādīm adhikaraṇam ākāśam tathā pṛthivī ādi sthānām ratha ādīnām api mukhya adhikaraṇam ākāśam samavāyinām tu sva āśraya dvārā paramāṇau viśrāmaḥ paramāṇūnām sarveṣām ādhāra śaktimān

original: atraiva lokaprasiddhimapi pramāṇayati| itamatretīti| iha prakṣī neha pakṣīti pratītyā ākāśasyaivādhāratvāt| yattu ākāśasyātīndriyatayā iha nakṣatramiti pratīterviṣaya āloka eveti tanna| ihāloka iti pratītyanāpatteḥ| vyapadeśa iti | ayaṃ yo vyavahārastasya nimittmākāśamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atra eva loka prasiddhim api pramāṇayati itam atra iti iti iha prakṣī na iha pakṣī iti pratītyā ākāśasya eva ādhāra tvāt yat tu ākāśasya atīndriya tayā iha nakṣatram iti pratīteḥ viṣayaḥ ālokaḥ eva iti tat na iha ālokaḥ iti pratīti anāpatteḥ vyapadeśaḥ iti ayam yaḥ vyavahāraḥ tasya nimittm ākāśam iti arthaḥ

original: ākāśasya sarvādhāratvaṃ yaduktaṃ tatsiddhaviṣayaṃ sādhyasvabhāvaviṣayaṃ tu kālasyādhāratvāmityāha| kāladiti| kāla eva kiriyāyā bhedaka ityarthaḥ| kālākāśādibhedo vyavahārika eva vāstavikastvabheda eva| nibandhanam| nimittam| vibhajyate iti| bhedena vyavahṛyata ityarthaḥ| sarvamūrtayaḥ| sarvapadārthāḥ|
analyzed: ākāśasya sarva ādhāra tvam yat uktam tat siddha viṣayam sādhya svabhāva viṣayam tu kālasya ādhāra tvām iti āha kālat iti kālaḥ eva kiriyāyāḥ bhedakaḥ iti arthaḥ kāla ākāśa ādi bhedaḥ vyavahārikaḥ eva vāstavikaḥ tu abhedaḥ eva nibandhanam nimittam vibhajyate iti bhedena vyavahṛyate iti arthaḥ sarva mūrtayaḥ sarva padārthāḥ

original: padārthasattāsattayorvibhājaka ākāśa evetyarthaḥ| nirdiṣṭeti | nirdiṣṭaṃ yannakṣatrādi tannirūpitamādhāratvaṃ pṛthivyāderna sambhavatītyarthaḥ| sarvādhāratvaṃ ghaṭayati| evaṃ ceti| pṛthvyādīnāmeva paramparayā paramāṇau viśrāntiḥ paramāṇūnāṃ cāradhāra ākāśa evetyarthaḥ| imaditi| pūrvāktavyavahārasiddhamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: padārtha sattā sattayoḥ vibhājakaḥ ākāśaḥ eva iti arthaḥ nirdiṣṭa iti nirdiṣṭam yat nakṣatra ādi tad nirūpitam ādhāra tvam pṛthivī ādeḥ na sambhavati iti arthaḥ sarva ādhāra tvam ghaṭayati evam ca iti pṛthvī ādīnām eva paramparayā paramāṇau viśrāntiḥ paramāṇūnām cāra dhāraḥ ākāśaḥ eva iti arthaḥ imat iti pūrvākta vyavahāra siddham iti arthaḥ

original: sādhyasvabhāvetyasya vivaraṇe kriyeti| janmasthitīti| ādyakṣaṇasambandho janma tatra kāla eva nimittamityarthaḥ| nirodho nāśaḥ|
analyzed: sādhya svabhāva ityasya vivaraṇe kriyā iti janma sthiti iti ādi akṣaṇa sambandhaḥ janma tatra kālaḥ eva nimittam iti arthaḥ nirodhaḥ nāśaḥ

original: ādityagrahanakṣatraparispandamathāpare|
analyzed: āditya graha nakṣatra parispandam atha apare

original: bhinnamāvṛttibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ||
analyzed: bhinnam āvṛtti bhedena kālam kāla vidaḥ viduḥ

original: iti| kecitkriyātmakaṃ kālamicchanti tānnarākaroti| kriyādhāra iti| ayaṃ ghaṭo bhavatītyādipratītyā kālasyaivāvāratvaṃ na tu sūryaparispandādeḥ sūryaniṣṭhasya tasyādhāratvāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| mūrtiśabdasya mūrtadharma eva tārkikāṇāṃ prasiddhitvādāhāmūrtimiti| vyāvahārika eveti| ata evoktaṃ dīdhitau dikvālau neśvarādatiricyete mānābhāvāditi|
analyzed: iti kecid kriyā ātmakam kālam icchanti tān narākaroti kriyā ādhāraḥ iti ayam ghaṭaḥ bhavati ityādi pratītyā kālasya eva āvāratvam na tu sūrya parispanda ādeḥ sūrya niṣṭhasya tasya ādhāra tva asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ mūrti śabdasya mūrta dharmaḥ eva tārkikāṇām prasiddhi tvāt āha amūrtim iti vyāvahārikaḥ eva iti atas eva uktam dīdhitau diś vālau na īśvarāt atiricyete māna abhāvāt iti

original: idānīṃ ghaṭastadānīṃ ghaṭa iti vyavahārabhedastu bhavatāmiva mamāpyaupādhika iti bhāvaḥ| īśvara eveti| śrotramiti| karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinna īśvara eveti bhāvaḥ| kāryamātraṃ prati īśvarasya ceśvare śabdasamāvāyasvīkāre manassaṃyukteśvarasamavāyasattvāttanmasāpattiriti vācyam|

analyzed: vapi jātīya saṃyoga vāraṇāya vapi jātīya saṃyogasya hetutayā tad abhāvāt na ca ākāśa śarīram brahma iti śruteḥ ākāśasya atirikta tva abhāve katham brahmaṇaḥ uvasthānam iti ced satyam yathā ākāśa antar ākāśasya sthitiḥ evam brahmaṇaḥ api śrutau tu ākaśa vat śarīram asya iti vivakṣitam akhaṇḍaḥ iti

analyzed: kṣaṇa māsa ādi rūpaḥ tu kālaḥ vyavahāra bheda anyathā anupapattyā aupādhikaḥ kalpyate iti bhāvaḥ khaṇḍanam iti kṣaṇa atirikta ukhaṇḍaḥ kālaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ sarva iti sarva vastunaḥ ādhāraḥ yaḥ ākāśaḥ tad adhikara maktavāt iti arthaḥ athavā ākāśa rūpaḥ deśaḥ sarva vastunaḥ ādhāra bhūtaḥ iti atas śabdasya api tad deśa tvam iti arthaḥ karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinnā iti

original: ākāśaguṇtavādākāśarūpaśrotrasambaddhasyaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ siddhimityarthaḥ| tattad‌bhūteti| tattadin‌riyātmakatattād‌bhūtetyarthaḥ| evam| śabdasyākāśādharmatvesatyevākāśātmakaśrotrasambaddhagrahaṇaṃ sambhavatītyarthaḥ|
