original: atra bauddhāḥ cakṣurgolakādau satighaṭādyupalambhādrolakameva cakṣurādītyāhuḥ |tatra sāṃkhyāḥ golakaṃ nendriyaṃ tasya ghaṭādideśe gamanāsambhavāt kiṃ tu tadatiriktam| tacca na bhautikam| cakṣuṣā hi nyūnaparimāṇaṃ na cāpyagrahaṇaṃ gṛhyate| na ca nyūnena mahato vāyapanaṃ sambhavati na cāpyagrahaṇa sambhavati ata āhaṅārikāṇīndrinyāmītyāhuḥ|
analyzed: atra bauddhāḥ cakṣuḥ golaka ādau sati ghaṭa ādi upalambhāt rolakam eva cakṣuḥ ādi iti āhuḥ tatra sāṃkhyāḥ golakam na indriyam tasya ghaṭa ādi deśe gamana asambhavāt kim tu tat atiriktam tat ca na bhautikam cakṣuṣā hi nyūna parimāṇam na ca api agrahaṇam gṛhyate na ca nyūnena mahataḥ sambhavati na ca api agrahaṇa sambhavati atas āhaṅārikāṇi indriyāṇi iti āhuḥ

original: etaccedbhūtavikāratvaśrutiviruddham| golakaniṣṭhā śaktirindriyamiti mīmāṃsakoktirapyayuktā| golakavirahiṇāṃ sarpādīnāmapi śabdānubhavāt| aṇutvamapyayuktam| sravaśarīravyāpiśautyopalambhāt| vibhutve sarveṣāṃ yugapadguhaṇaprasaṅgānmadhyamaparimāṇam|| 1.53 ||
analyzed: etat ced bhūta vikāra tva śruti viruddham golaka niṣṭhā śaktiḥ indriyam iti mīmāṃsaka uktiḥ api ayuktā golaka virahiṇām sarpa ādīnām api śabda anubhavāt aṇu tvam api ayuktam srava śarīra vyāpi śautya upalambhāt vibhu tve sarveṣām yugapad guhaṇa prasaṅgāt madhyama parimāṇam

original: tanna śrotramiti| śrotrasya nabhorūpatve rogādinā nāśo na syādityarthaḥ| lāghaveneti| dharmikalpanāyāmubhayakalpane gauravāditi bhāvaḥ| nabhodhiṣṭhānaketi| karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnanabhoniṣṭhetyarthaḥ| dharmaviśeṣeti| śabdagrahamayogyarthaḥ| āhaṅkārikasyeti|
analyzed: tat na śrotram iti śrotrasya nabhaḥ rūpa tve roga ādinā nāśaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ lāghavena iti dharmi kalpanāyām ubhaya kalpane gauravāt iti bhāvaḥ nabhaḥ adhiṣṭhānaka iti karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinna nabhaḥ niṣṭhā iti arthaḥ dharma viśeṣa iti śabda graham ayogi arthaḥ āhaṅkārikasya iti

original: sātvikāṅkāradindriyāṇīti sāṃkhyamate indriyāṇāṃ svādhiṣṭhānabhūtavṛttiguṇagrāhakatvāt śrotropalabdhyā labdasyakāśadeśatvam| ghrāṇādīti| nāsikāvacchinnavṛvīdharmo prāṇamityādirītyetyarthaḥ| yattu gandhagrāhakatbād‌ghrāṇaṃ pārthivamiti tārkikāstannetyāha| āhahaṅkārikāṇyeveti|
analyzed: sātvika aṅkāra dindriyāṇi iti sāṃkhya mate indriyāṇām sva adhiṣṭhāna bhūtavṛtti guṇa grāhaka tvāt śrotra upalabdhyā ghrāṇa ādi iti prāṇam ityādi rītyā iti arthaḥ yat tu gandha grāhaka tvāt ghrāṇam pārthivam iti tārkikāḥ tat na iti āha āhahaṅkārikāṇi eva iti

original: ayambhāvaḥ ghrāṇādinā vyūnaparimāṇena mahāparimāṇaṃ gṛhyate na mahato vyāpanaṃ sambhavati avyāpyagrahaṇe cātiprasaṅgastasmād‌bhautikādatiriktamindriyamiti| ata eveti| ghrāṇasya pārthivatvena deśāntare gamanābhāvātpratyakṣaṃ na syādityarthaḥ| tāvaddeśeti| ata eva golakameva ca kṣuriti bauddhamatamapāstam|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ ghrāṇa ādinā vyūna parimāṇena mahā parimāṇam gṛhyate na mahataḥ vyāpanam sambhavati a vyāpya grahaṇe ca atiprasaṅgaḥ tasmāt bhautikāt atiriktam indriyam iti atas eva iti ghrāṇasya pārthiva tvena deśa antare gamana abhāvāt pratyakṣam na syāt iti arthaḥ tāvat deśa iti atas eva golakam eva ca kṣuḥ iti bauddha matam apāstam

original: ahaṅkāro 'hamiti prathamādhyāsaḥ svapnāvasthāyāṃ nasya vyāghratvābhimāne sati na naro 'hamityabhimāno bhavati atastanniyamāya niyataviṣavyāpako'haṅkāraḥ svīkāryaḥ sa ca buddhitattvasya pariṇāmaḥ| jāgratsva pnasuṣuptiṣuśvāsapraśyavāsadarśanātsavyāpāraṃ yadanuvartate tad‌buddhitattvam| antaḥ karaṇapariṇāmatvāditi |
analyzed: ahaṅkāraḥ ham iti prathama adhyāsaḥ svapna avasthāyām vyāghra tva abhimāne sati na naraḥ ham iti abhimānaḥ bhavati atas tad niyamāya niyata viṣa vyāpakaḥ uhaṅkāraḥ svīkāryaḥ sa ca buddhi tattvasya pariṇāmaḥ yat anuvartate tat buddhi tattvam antar karaṇa pariṇāma tvāt iti

original: manobuddhirahaṅkāraścittaṃ ceti catvāri antaḥ karaṇāni garvarūpavṛttiviśeṣādahaṅkārasaṃjñāṃ labhante|tadvikāreti| antaḥ karaṇavikāro yo 'haṅkārastadvikārāṇāmindriyāṇāmityarthaḥ| nanu na yogīndriyāṇāṃ dūradeśagamanaṃ kintu yogajadharma eva pratyakṣe sahakārītyāśaṅkyāha| yogastviti| tamonivartaka iti| suṣuptau tamaso vṛttipratibandhakatvadarśanāt|
analyzed: manaḥ buddhiḥ ahaṅkāraḥ cittam ca iti catvāri antar karaṇāni garva rūpa vṛtti viśeṣāt ahaṅkāra saṃjñām labhante tad vikāra iti antar karaṇa vikāraḥ yaḥ haṅkāraḥ tad vikārāṇām indriyāṇām iti arthaḥ nanu na yogi indriyāṇām dūra deśa gamanam kintu yoga ja dharmaḥ eva pratyakṣe sahakāri iti āśaṅkya āha yogaḥ tu iti tamaḥ nivartakaḥ iti suṣuptau tamasaḥ vṛtti pratibandhaka tva darśanāt

original: tataśca yogināmapi indriyasambandhādeva pratyakṣabhūtabhaviṣyatorapi sūkṣmāvasthāsannikarṣeṇa pratyakṣam|indriyāṇāmantarbahirbhāvasya vyavasthitānāṃ sthirā avicālino dhāraṇaikāgryalakṣaṇo yogaḥ| nanvindriyāṇāṃ gumāśrayatve cakṣurādinā gandhādīnāmapi pratyakṣāpattirata āha| tattad‌guṇeti|
analyzed: tatas ca yoginām api indriya sambandhāt eva pratyakṣa bhūta bhaviṣyatoḥ api sūkṣma avasthā sannikarṣeṇa pratyakṣam indriyāṇām antar bahis bhāvasya vyavasthitānām sthirāḥ avicālinaḥ dhāraṇa aikāgrya lakṣaṇaḥ yogaḥ nanu indriyāṇām guma āśraya tve cakṣuḥ ādinā gandha ādīnām api pratyakṣa āpattiḥ atas āha tad tad guṇa iti

original: śrotragrāhyasya śabdasyāśraya ākāśaḥ śabdaścanubhūta iti na sarvadā pratyakṣaṃ kiṃ tu śrotraśabdayoḥ sambandhe sati pratyakṣamityarthaḥ| anudbhūta iti|tena cakṣurādau na rūpādipratyakṣam| nanu ghrāṇasya sambandho yogo dravye 'sti na tu gandha ityata āha| sāmānādhikaraṇyaditi| śrotrameveti|
analyzed: śrotra grāhyasya śabdasya āśrayaḥ ākāśaḥ śabdaḥ ca anubhūtaḥ iti na sarvadā pratyakṣam kim tu śrotra śabdayoḥ sambandhe sati pratyakṣam iti arthaḥ anudbhūtaḥ iti tena cakṣuḥ ādau na rūpa ādi pratyakṣam nanu ghrāṇasya sambandhaḥ yogaḥ dravye sti na tu gandhaḥ iti atas āha sāmānādhikaraṇyat iti śrotram eva iti

original: antaḥ karaṇamevendriyadvārā viṣayadeśe gatvā gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ|tīrkikamate manaḥ saṃyogasyāpi jñānahetutvāduktaṃ cittavṛttīti| etanmate vṛttiverendriyasannikarṣaḥ | ata eveti| yadi hi śrotradeśe eva pratyakṣaṃ syāttadā grāmāntare śabdaḥ śrūyata iti pratītirna syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: antar karaṇam eva indriya dvārā viṣaya deśe gatvā gṛhṇāti iti arthaḥ tīrkika mate manaḥ saṃyogasya api jñāna hetu tvāt uktam citta vṛtti iti etad mate atas eva iti yadi hi śrotra deśe eva pratyakṣam syāt tadā grāma antare śabdaḥ śrūyate iti pratītiḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: yadyapi karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnanabhorūpaśrotrasya deśāntaragamanaṃ na sambhavati tathāpi śrotraṃ paricchinnaparimāṇamityuktameva| vīcītaraṅgādinyāyena śrotragataṃ śabdāntaraṃ gṛhṇata iti tu na yuktam| bherīśabdo mayā śruta ityanubhavavirodhāt| bhramādikalpane bījābhāvāt| sarvaśaktīnām| sarvaśaktiyuktānām| nabha ādīti|
analyzed: yadi api karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinna nabhaḥ rūpa śrotrasya deśa antara gamanam na sambhavati tathā api śrotram paricchinna parimāṇam iti uktam eva vīcī taraṅga ādi nyāyena śrotra gatam śabda antaram gṛhṇataḥ iti tu na yuktam bherī śabdaḥ mayā śrutaḥ iti anubhava virodhāt bhrama ādi kalpane bīja abhāvāt sarva śaktīnām sarva śakti yuktānām nabhaḥ ādi iti

original: nabhaḥ paramāṇūnāmeva śabdadeśe śrotratvena pariṇāma ityarthaḥ| paramāṇūnāmiti| tattadindriyarūpeṇa pariṇāmādityatrānvayaḥ | nanu paramāṇūnāmevendriyatve asannikṛṣṭasyāpi pratyakṣāpattirata āha| viṣayadeśeti| pratyakṣaviṣayadeśetyarthaḥ|| 1.54||
analyzed: nabhaḥ paramāṇūnām eva śabda deśe śrotra tvena pariṇāmaḥ iti arthaḥ paramāṇūnām iti tad tad indriya rūpeṇa pariṇāmāt iti atra anvayaḥ nanu paramāṇūnām eva indriya tve asannikṛṣṭasya api pratyakṣa āpattiḥ atas āha viṣaya deśa iti pratyakṣa viṣaya deśa iti arthaḥ

original: krameṇa dūṣayati| kiñceti| nanu śrotrasyaikatve dūravartitvānubhavo na syādata āha| savyāpīti| abhivyaktireva dūradeśaṃ vyāpnotītyarthaḥ| nanu sakaladeśasthasya śabdasyaikatve tatra jātyabhāvādākṛtirgṛhyata iti bhāṣyāsaṅgatirata āha| yathā ceti| nabhaso janyatvaṃ taittirīyake prasiddham | chāndogye tu nityatvamuktam|
analyzed: krameṇa dūṣayati kiñca iti nanu śrotrasya ekatve dūra varti tva anubhavaḥ na syāt atas āha savyāpi iti abhivyaktiḥ eva dūra deśam vyāpnoti iti arthaḥ nanu sakala deśa sthasya śabdasya ekatve tatra jāti abhāvāt ākṛtiḥ gṛhyate iti bhāṣya asaṅgatiḥ atas āha yathā ca iti nabhasaḥ janya tvam taittirīyake prasiddham chāndogye tu nitya tvam uktam

original: virodhaparihāro gauṇamukhyavyapadeśābhyāṃ śārīrakabhāṣye vyaktaḥ| jīveśvareti| antaḥ karaṇasāhityābhyāṃ jīveśvarayorbhedāt| aupādhikamiti| dhvanigatabhedasya varṇeṣvāropāt| ākṛtigrahaṇāditi| aiuṇ ityādāvakārādyākṛtirgṛhyata ityarthaḥ| anyathā| sakalasādṛśyagrahaṇe | tairena | varṇaireva| kiṃ teona| kiṃ sphoṭena| sarvasyeti|
analyzed: virodha parihāraḥ gauṇa mukhya vyapadeśābhyām śārīraka bhāṣye vyaktaḥ jīva īśvara iti antar karaṇa sāhityābhyām jīva īśvarayoḥ bhedāt aupādhikam iti dhvani gata bhedasya varṇeṣu āropāt ākṛti grahaṇāt iti ityādau akāra ādi ākṛtiḥ gṛhyate iti arthaḥ anyathā sakala sādṛśya grahaṇe taiḥ ena varṇaiḥ eva kim kim sphoṭena sarvasya iti

original: agṛhītasaṅketasyāpītyarthaḥ| yadīti| sphoṭasya bodhako yadi varṇasamudāyasyā so 'rthasyaiva bodhako 'stu kiṃ sphoṭena, yadi ca sa na sphoṭabodhakastadā ajñātasya sphoṭasyārthabodhakatvāsambhavāt sphoṭo vyartha ityarthaḥ|| 1.55||
analyzed: agṛhīta saṅketasya api iti arthaḥ yadi iti sphoṭasya bodhakaḥ yadi saḥ ṛthasya eva astu kim sphoṭena yadi ca sa na sphoṭa bodhakaḥ tadā ajñātasya sphoṭasya artha bodhaka tva asambhavāt sphoṭaḥ vyarthaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: agṛhīteti| saṅketāgrahe'pi padatvānubhavādityarthaḥ| avarṇādīnāmiti| sarvatrākāro vibhutvādeka eva evaṃ varṇāntaramapītyarthaḥ| tadavayavaketi| ākārādighaṭitapadasyāpi nityādityarthaḥ| nanvakārādernityatve sarvadā tadupalabhambhaḥ syādata āha| kaṇṭhatālvādīti| deśabhede 'pīti|
analyzed: agṛhīta iti saṅketa agrahe api pada tva anubhavāt iti arthaḥ avarṇa ādīnām iti sarvatra ākāraḥ vibhu tvāt ekaḥ eva evam varṇa antaram api iti arthaḥ tad avayavaka iti ākāra ādi ghaṭita padasya api nityāt iti arthaḥ nanu akāra ādeḥ nitya tve sarvadā tad upalabhambhaḥ syāt atas āha kaṇṭha tālu ādi iti deśa bhede pi iti

original: yathā ūrdhvadhodeśāvacchinnasyākṛtiviśeṣasya saṃsthānatayā prativyakti deśabhede'pi na saṃsthānabheda evaṃ pade kālaghaṭitānurvyā na bheda ityarthaḥ| pratyakṣapratyabhijñānāt| so'yaṃ kakāra iti pratīteḥ|| 1.56||
analyzed: yathā ūrdhva adhas deśa avacchinnasya ākṛti viśeṣasya saṃsthāna tayā prativyakti deśa bhede pi na saṃsthāna bhedaḥ evam pade kāla ghaṭitān urvyāḥ na bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ pratyakṣa pratyabhijñānāt saḥ ayam kakāraḥ iti pratīteḥ

original: vyatireke| abhāve| nanu varṇānāṃ vibhutvanityatve ca ghakāre tādṛśāvyavahitottarakṣaṇotpattikatvarūpānuṣūrvo kathamata āha| avyavahitottaratveti| svajñāneti| utpattyanavacchinnoti| nanu tṛtīyakṣaṇe jñānasya nāśāttṛtīyādivarṇādhikaraṇakālasya kathaṃ pūrvajñānavattvamata āha| jñānānāmapīti|
analyzed: vyatireke abhāve nanu varṇānām vibhu tva nitya tve ca ghakāre katham atas āha avyavahita uttara tva iti sva jñāna iti utpatti anavacchinna iti nanu tṛtīya kṣaṇe jñānasya nāśāt tṛtīya ādi varṇa adhikaraṇa kālasya katham pūrva jñānavat tvam atas āha jñānānām api iti

original: ayambhāvaḥ dhārāvāhikabuddhisthale na jñānabhedaḥ kintu yāvaddhaṭasphuraṇaṃ tāvaddhaṭākārāntaḥ karaṇavṛttirekaiva na tu nānā| svavirodhivṛtyutpattiparyantaṃ vṛtteḥ sthiratvābhyupagamāt| tatphalitacaitanyaṃ ghaṭādijñānātmakamapi tāvatkālikameveti| kiñca jñānadhārākalpane anadhigatārthaviṣayakajñānatvaṃ pramātvamiti lakṣaṇasyāvyāptiḥ|| 1.57||

original: yo vārtha iti| vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntare| budhdyupārūḍhasya śabdasya bāhyavastunibandhano budhdyupārūḍho yo'rthaḥ sa bāhyaṃ vastvidhyastaḥ san śabdārthaḥ| yathā āntaraḥ sphoṭo vācakaḥ tathā 'rtho 'pyāntara eveti bhāvaḥ| nanvatrādhyāse bījābhāva ityata āha rāgādidoṣa iti| tadvaśādeva pravṛttiriti bhāvaḥ|"sukhānuśayī rāgaḥ " iti pātañjalasūtram|
analyzed: yaḥ vā arthaḥ iti vā śabdaḥ pakṣa antare budhdi upārūḍhasya śabdasya bāhya vastu nibandhanaḥ budhdi upārūḍhaḥ yaḥ ṛthaḥ sa bāhyam vastu idhyastaḥ san śabda arthaḥ yathā āntaraḥ sphoṭaḥ vācakaḥ tathā eva iti bhāvaḥ nanu atra adhyāse bīja abhāvaḥ iti atas āha rāga ādi doṣaḥ iti tad vaśāt eva pravṛttiḥ iti bhāvaḥ sukha anuśayī rāgaḥ iti pātañjala sūtram

original: sukhe tatkāraṇe vā tṛṣṇā rāga iti tadarthaḥ| a eva-- bāhye adhyāsādeva| saṃvādaḥ--aikyam| evameveti| saṃvāditvāsaṃvāditvābhyāmevetyarthaḥ| jñāne saṃvādo nāma yathārthaviṣayakatvam| pramāṇamiti| bāhyārthasaṃvādītyarthaḥ| || 1.103 ||
analyzed: sukhe tad kāraṇe vā tṛṣṇā rāgaḥ iti tad arthaḥ eva bāhye adhyāsāt eva saṃvādaḥ aikyam evam eva iti saṃvādi tva asaṃvādi tvābhyām eva iti arthaḥ jñāne saṃvādaḥ nāma yathārtha viṣayaka tvam pramāṇam iti bāhya artha saṃvādi iti arthaḥ

original: nanu nalādiśabdānāmādhunikatvāttatra kathaṃ vāsanā kathaṃ vā bauddhabāhyayoradhyāsa ityata āha nalādīti| bauddheti| asti hi ākāraviṣayiṇī vāsanā anādiḥ| nanu ajñātasya ākāro'pi kathaṃ buddhistha ityata āha saceti| sāmānyakārasya sarvatrānumānādinā buddhisthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| teṣām-- nalādipadānām | śaktigraho'pīti |
analyzed: nanu nala ādi śabdānām ādhunika tvāt tatra katham vāsanā katham vā bauddha bāhyayoḥ adhyāsaḥ iti atas āha nala ādi iti bauddha iti asti hi ākāra viṣayiṇī vāsanā anādiḥ nanu ajñātasya ākāraḥ api katham buddhi sthaḥ iti atas āha sacā iti sāmānyakārasya sarvatra anumāna ādinā buddhi stha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ teṣām nala ādi padānām śaktigrahaḥ api iti

original: budhdyā gṛhīte ākāre ityatrānvayaḥ | vyutpādānāvasara iti| citrapustakādau hi pratikṛtirūpasya prayojyaprayojakabhāvādhyavasāyātkaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti siddham| yadā tu saṃsādyanukāreṇa sādṛśyānnaṭānāṃ tadrūpatāpratītiḥ tatra prāthamikeṣu kathamiti tatra praśnaḥ| teṣāmutpattītiḥ |
analyzed: budhdyā gṛhīte ākāre iti atra anvayaḥ vyutpādāna avasaraḥ iti citra pustaka ādau hi pratikṛti rūpasya prayojya prayojaka bhāva adhyavasāyāt kaṃsam ghātayati iti siddham yadā tu saṃsa ādi anukāreṇa sādṛśyāt naṭānām tad rūpa tā pratītiḥ tatra prāthamikeṣu katham iti tatra praśnaḥ teṣām utpatti itiḥ

original: kaṃsādīnām ṝddhīrvyācakṣāṇāḥ kathakā buddhiviṣayān prakāśayanti cirakālātītānāṃ bahirasattavāt buddhigocaratayā vidyamānān prakāśayanti| tathā ca kathakaiḥ śrotari kaṃsādyākārapratyayajananād buddhivāsudevena kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti prayojakatvopapattiḥ| tathā ca sūtreṇaiva siddhatvādvārtikaṃ nārabdhavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kaṃsa ādīnām ṝddhīḥ vyācakṣāṇāḥ kathakāḥ buddhi viṣayān prakāśayanti cira kāla atītānām bahis asattavāt buddhi gocara tayā vidyamānān prakāśayanti tathā ca kathakaiḥ śrotari kaṃsa ādi ākāra pratyaya jananāt buddhi vāsudevena kaṃsam ghātayati iti prayojaka tva upapattiḥ tathā ca sūtreṇa eva siddha tvāt vārtikam na ārabdhavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca buddhiviṣayasattayaiva sarvo'pi vyavahāra iti phalitam|| 1.104||
analyzed: evam ca buddhi viṣaya sattayā eva sarvaḥ api vyavahāraḥ iti phalitam

original: śabdopahiteti| śabdasamarpitabuddhiviṣayākārānityarthaḥ| sādhanatveneti| buddhiviṣayavadhāderityarthaḥ| tadevaṃ buddhyā vyavahāramupapādyaikasyāpi vastunaḥ śaktinānātvaṃ bauddhamityāha buddhīti| baddheḥ pravṛttirvyāpāraḥ paricchedalakṣaṇaḥ tasyā rūpamākāraḥ avidyayā bhāsamānastamartheṣu bāhyeṣvadhyasya teṣāṃ śaktinānātvaṃ kalpyate|
analyzed: śabda upahita iti śabda samarpita buddhi viṣaya ākārān iti arthaḥ sādhana tvena iti buddhi viṣaya vadha ādeḥ iti arthaḥ tat evam buddhyāḥ vyavahāram upapādya ekasya api vastunaḥ śakti nānātvam bauddham iti āha buddhī iti baddheḥ pravṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ pariccheda lakṣaṇaḥ tasyāḥ rūpam ākāraḥ avidyayā bhāsamānaḥ tam artheṣu bāhyeṣu adhyasya teṣām śakti nānātvam kalpyate

original: tathāca bauddhaśaktibhedaḥ | evaṃ ca kriyābhedādvastveva nānāśaktikamavadhāryate| kriyāviśeṣaṇamiti| indriyanimittena jñānena parisphuṭārthamavadhārayatītyartha iti bhāvaḥ| ivārthamāha indriyajeti| indriyajanyamidaṃ jñānaṃ na bhavatīti hetoḥ pratyakṣamiveti ivaśabdaḥ prayukta ityarthaḥ| dṛśyeti| bāhyetyarthaḥ| jñānaviṣayaḥ --bauddhaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca bauddha śakti bhedaḥ evam ca kriyā bhedāt vastu eva nānā śaktikam avadhāryate kriyā viśeṣaṇam iti indriya nimittena jñānena parisphuṭa artham avadhārayati iti arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ iva artham āha indriya ja iti indriya janyam idam jñānam na bhavati iti hetoḥ pratyakṣam iva iti iva śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ iti arthaḥ dṛśyā iti bāhyā iti arthaḥ jñāna viṣayaḥ bauddhaḥ

original: ata eva-- bauddhasāmānyakāre śaktigrahādeva| ' deśāntare vartate' ityaparicitaṃ devadattaṃ śrutavataḥ kāsīsthapuṃsaḥ kāśyāṃ devadatte satyapi ' kāśyāṃ devadatte nāsti' iti vākyādbodho bhavatyeva | buddhisthasya sāmānyākārasya bāhyākāre 'dhyāsābhāvādityarthaḥ| saṃmugdhatvena --abhinnatvena| asya -- kāśīsthasya |
analyzed: atas eva bauddha sāmānyakāre śakti grahāt eva deśa antare vartate iti aparicitam devadattam śrutavataḥ kāsī stha puṃsaḥ kāśyām devadatte sati api kāśyām devadatte na asti iti vākyāt bodhaḥ bhavati eva buddhi sthasya sāmānya ākārasya bāhya ākāre dhyāsa abhāvāt iti arthaḥ saṃmugdha tvena abhinna tvena asya kāśī sthasya

original: nanūpadeśāt ' so'yam ' iti buddhiḥ katham ata āha ayaṃ sa iti | vijātīyeti| (vijātī--tyarthaḥ pāṭho'yaṃ kuṃo kapuo nāsti)etacca saṃmugdhatve hetuḥ| mohaścājñānam| tathāca mohād dvayorākārayornekyagraha ityarthaḥ| saḥ ---deśāntarasthaḥ| ayamevetyarthaḥ| bauddha iti| tatropadeśānantaraṃ bauddha ākāro bāhyarūpo bhavatītyarthaḥ| ātītanalādīti|
analyzed: nanu upadeśāt saḥ ayam iti buddhiḥ katham atas āha ayam saḥ iti vijātīya iti vijāti iti arthaḥ pāṭhaḥ yam na asti etat ca saṃmugdha tve hetuḥ mohaḥ ca ajñānam tathā ca mohāt dvayoḥ ākārayoḥ nekya grahaḥ iti arthaḥ saḥ deśa antara sthaḥ ayam eva iti arthaḥ bauddhaḥ iti tatra upadeśa anantaram bauddhaḥ ākāraḥ bāhya rūpaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ ātīta nala ādi iti

original: atītanalādiviṣaye nalatvādiprakārakaḥ śaktigraho na sambhavati, nalatvādinā pūrvamajñātatvāt kintu prameyavānityeva prameyaprakārakaḥ | prameyavānityanubhave prameyatvena nalatvaviśiṣṭasyāpi pūrvamanubhavo'sti |evaṃ cādṛṣṭaviśeṣasya prameyatvāṃśe ud‌bodhakatvākalpanena kevalacaitrtavaviśiṣṭasmaraṇamiti prāñcaḥ|
analyzed: atīta nala ādi viṣaye nala tva ādi prakārakaḥ śaktigrahaḥ na sambhavati nala tva ādinā pūrvam ajñāta tvāt kintu prameyavān iti eva prameya prakārakaḥ prameyavān iti anubhave prameya tvena nala tva viśiṣṭasya api pūrvam anubhavaḥ usti evam ca adṛṣṭa viśeṣasya prameya tva aṃśe udbodhaka tva akalpanena kevala caitrtava viśiṣṭa smaraṇam iti prāñcaḥ

original: tanna| ' jātimān ' iti anubhavottaraṃ ' ghaṭa ' iti smaramāṣatteḥ| nahi tatra kasyod‌bodhakatvamasti kasya netyatra niyāmamasti | atastatra saṃskāradhārakalpanenaiva smṛtiriti navyāḥ||1.105||
analyzed: tat na jātimān iti anubhava uttaram ghaṭaḥ iti smara māṣatteḥ nahi tatra kasya udbodhaka tvam asti kasya na iti atra atas tatra saṃskāra dhāra kalpanena eva smṛtiḥ iti navyāḥ

original: bhāvīti| nalādiryo'tītaḥ yaśca bhāvī caitrādiḥ yaśca prasiddho vartamāno'pi asannikṛṣṭa ityeteṣāṃ dvandvaḥ| hetvasiddheriti| viśiṣya bodhābhāvena tanmūlakasaṃskārakalpanāyā asambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| gṛhīteti| ghaṭadarśane ghaṭapadasmaraṇavadapūrvacaitrādidarśane 'pi tadvācakapadasmaramāpatterityarthaḥ| padaprakāraketi|
analyzed: bhāvī iti yaḥ ca bhāvī caitra ādiḥ yaḥ ca prasiddhaḥ vartamānaḥ api asannikṛṣṭaḥ iti eteṣām dvandvaḥ hetu asiddheḥ iti viśiṣya bodha abhāvena tad mūlaka saṃskāra kalpanāyāḥ asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ gṛhīta iti ghaṭa darśane ghaṭa pada smaraṇa vat apūrva caitra ādi darśane pi tad vācaka pada smarama āpatteḥ iti arthaḥ pada prakāraka iti

original: nalapadavācyaḥ kaścidāsīdinyākāraketyarthaḥ| evaṃ padamitīti| etādṛśo vyavahāra iti śeṣaḥ| jñāteṣvita| tārkikamate tu nalaśabde jñāte tadarthasyāpi jñātatvātpraśnānupapattiḥ| upamānasyeti| prāmāṇyamityatrānvayaḥ|
analyzed: nala pada vācyaḥ kaścid āsīt ini ākāraka iti arthaḥ evam padam iti iti etādṛśaḥ vyavahāraḥ iti śeṣaḥ jñāteṣu ita tārkika mate tu nala śabde jñāte tad arthasya api jñāta tvāt praśna anupapattiḥ upamānasya iti prāmāṇyam iti atra anvayaḥ

original: tatra hi ---' gosadṛśo gavayapadāvacyaḥ' ityupamānād ' gavayo gavayapadāvacyaḥ ' iti śaktigrahaḥ | sādṛśyadītyādinā vaidharmyaparigrahaḥ| yathā atidīrghagrīvatvādipaśvantaravaidharmyāt uṣṭre karabhapadavācyatāgrahaḥ|
analyzed: tatra hi go sadṛśaḥ gavaya pada avacyaḥ iti upamānāt gavayaḥ gavaya pada avacyaḥ iti śakti grahaḥ sādṛśya di ityādinā vaidharmya parigrahaḥ yathā ati dīrgha grīva tva ādi paśu antara vaidharmyāt uṣṭre karabha pada vācya tā grahaḥ

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyāt-- vācyatayā ekārthavṛttitvāt| śaktigrahāsambhavāditi| nalatvena rūpeṇa pūrvamanupasthiteḥ| moṣe agrahe| tadaṃśe 'nyāprakārakasmṛtiṃ prati tadaṃśe'nyāprakārakatvena tu nānubhavasya hetutvam, mānābhāvāt | nacaivaṃ jātimattvādirūpeṇa ghaṭādyanubhave 'nyāṃśe udbodhakālābhe ' ghaṭaḥ' smaraṇāpattiriti vācyam|
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇyāt vācyatayā ekārtha vṛtti tvāt śaktigraha asambhavāt iti nala tvena rūpeṇa pūrvam anupasthiteḥ moṣe agrahe tad aṃśe nya a prakāraka smṛtim prati tad aṃśe nya a prakāraka tvena tu na anubhavasya hetu tvam māna abhāvāt na ca evam jātimat tva ādi rūpeṇa ghaṭa ādi anubhave udbodhaka alābhe ghaṭaḥ smaraṇa āpattiḥ iti vācyam

original: udbodhakalābhayoḥ phalabalakalpyatvāt iti bhāvaḥ| tattajjātyādīti| caitratvādītyarthaḥ| nirvikalpakamiti| yathā bālānāṃ stanapānādāviṣṭasādhanatāyāḥ pūrvānubhūtāyāḥ smaraṇe'dṛṣṭaviśeṣa eva niyāmakaḥ, tathā'pūrvacaitratvādismaraṇe'pītyarthaḥ| ātmavṛttīte| ātmaniṣṭhetyarthaḥ| ' surabhi candanaṃ paśyāmi' ityādau saurabhasmṛtau heturiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: udbodhaka lābhayoḥ phala bala kalpya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ tat tat jāti ādi iti caitra tva ādi iti arthaḥ nirvikalpakam iti yathā bālānām stana pāna ādau iṣṭa sādhanatāyāḥ pūrva anubhūtāyāḥ smaraṇa idṛṣṭa viśeṣaḥ eva niyāmakaḥ tathā pūrva caitra tva ādi smaraṇe api iti arthaḥ ātma vṛtti ite ātma niṣṭha ityarthaḥ surabhi candanam paśyāmi ityādau saurabha smṛtau hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: na sārvajñyāpattiriti| prameyatvena jñāne'pi biśiṣya jñānābhāvānna sarvajñatāpattirityarthaḥ| tādṛśeti| prameyatvarūpemānubhavāccaitratvarūpeṇa smaraṇetyarthaḥ| anubhavākārtavasyaiveti|
analyzed: na sārvajñya āpattiḥ iti prameya tvena jñāne api viśiṣya jñāna abhāvāt na sarvajña tā āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ tādṛśa iti smaraṇa iti arthaḥ anubhava akārtavasya eva iti

original: tathā ca pātañjalasūtram " jātideśakālavyavahitānāmapyānantaryaṃ smṛtisaṃskārayorekarūpatvād " iti | jātivyavahitatvaṃ janmāntarayogena | tatra janmāntarā'nubhūtasmaraṇamañjanādinā| deśādivyavadhānaṃ dūratvādinā| naca suṣuptidaśāyāmanubhavābhāvāt ' sukhamahamasvāpsaṃ na kiñcidavodiṣam ' iti smaramānupapattiriti vācyam|
analyzed: tathā ca pātañjala sūtram jāti deśa kāla vyavahitānām api ānantaryam smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt iti jāti vyavahita tvam janmāntara yogena tatra janmāntara anubhūta smaraṇam añjana ādinā deśa ādi vyavadhānam dūra tva ādinā na ca suṣupti daśāyām anubhava abhāvāt sukham aham asvāpsam na kiñcid avodiṣam iti smaramā anupapattiḥ iti vācyam

original: etadarthameva nidrāyā vṛttiviśeṣatvasyaiva svīkārāt | etena jñānasāmānyābhāvo nidreti tārkikoktamapāstam|| 1.106||
analyzed: etad artham eva nidrāyāḥ vṛtti viśeṣa tvasya eva svīkārāt etena jñāna sāmānya abhāvaḥ nidrā iti tārkika uktam apāstam

original: nanu tadviṣayakasmṛtau tadvipayakānubhavahetutāyāṃ vyabhicāravāraṇāyāvyavahitottaratvaṃ vaijātyaṃ vā niveśyamityasvarasādāha kiñca tadaṃśeti| yasya kasya cidviśiṣyānubhavo jāto 'sti tasyaiva jñānalakṣaṇayā'pi jñānaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| natviti| tathā 'nanubhūtānāṃ jñānalakṣaṇayā 'pi na tathā jñānamityanvayaḥ| brahmaṇo 'pīti|
analyzed: nanu tad viṣayaka smṛtau tad vipayaka anubhava hetutāyām vyabhicāra vāraṇāya avyavahita uttara tvam vaijātyam vā niveśyam iti asvarasāt āha kiñca tad aṃśa iti yasya kasya cit viśiṣya anubhavaḥ sti tasya eva jñāna lakṣaṇayā api jñānam bhavati iti arthaḥ na tu iti tathā nanu bhūtānām jñāna lakṣaṇayā pi na tathā jñānam iti anvayaḥ brahmaṇaḥ pi iti

original: asmadādīnāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇayā brahmaṇo'pyanubhavānmuktatvāpattirityarthaḥ||1.107||
analyzed: asmat ādīnām sāmānya lakṣaṇayā brahmaṇaḥ api anubhavāt mukta tva āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: bahudheti| nalādipadaghaṭādipadebhyo viśeṣyasyānekadhā bhānāt| upamitau ayaṃ gavayapadavācya ityādinā bahuvidhatvāt| arthabādhetviti| arthasyoccāraṇāsambhavāt| śabdamātreti| tatrārthasya apratītireva| tata eveti| śabdārthayorabhedādevetyarthaḥ| anuviddhamiti| śabdārthayorabhede śabdapūrvakatvasyaiva nyāyyatvāt| anuvyavasāyaḥ pramāṇamiti|
analyzed: bahudhā iti nala ādi pada ghaṭa ādi padebhyaḥ viśeṣyasya anekadhā bhānāt upamitau ayam gavaya pada vācyaḥ ityādinā bahuvidha tvāt artha bādhetu iti arthasya uccāraṇa asambhavāt śabda mātrā iti tatra arthasya apratītiḥ eva tatas eva iti śabda arthayoḥ abhedāt eva iti arthaḥ anuviddham iti śabda arthayoḥ abhede śabda pūrvakatvasya eva nyāyya tvāt anuvyavasāyaḥ pramāṇam iti

original: pratyakṣe śabdādīnāṃ viṣayatvāsambhavāttaduttarotpanne 'nuvyavasāye śabdo viṣaya ityarthaḥ| anuvyavasāya eva jñānasya bhānāduktam uttarārddheti| ata eva-- śabdānuviddhatvādeva| ajñānatabodhakamiti| na jñāto bodhako vācako yasya tam| śabdānuviddhisyaiva bhānāt vācakaśabdājñāne 'rthasyāpyajñātvavyahāra ityarthaḥ|| 1.108||
analyzed: pratyakṣe śabda ādīnām viṣaya tva asambhavāt tad uttara utpanne nuvyavasāye śabdaḥ viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ anuvyavasāye eva jñānasya bhānāt uktam uttara arddha iti atas eva śabda anuviddha tvāt eva ajñānataḥ bodhakam iti na jñātaḥ bodhakaḥ vācakaḥ yasya tam bhānāt vācaka śabda ajñāne rthasya api ajñātva vyahāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: maṇimantrādīti|
analyzed: maṇi mantra ādi iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-- ' hrado vahnyabhāvavān' itiniścayānantaraṃ ' hrado vahnimān' iti buddheranudayāttadvattābuddhiṃ prati tadabhāvavattāniścayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ| tatra ca grāhyābhāvānavagāhitve 'pi yathā dāhaṃ prati maṇyādorviśiṣyaiva pratibandhakatā evaṃ caitratvādinā viśiṣya śaktigrahād bodhādirityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ hradaḥ vahni abhāvavān iti niścaya anantaram hradaḥ vahnimān iti buddheḥ anudayāt tadvat tā buddhim prati tad abhāvavat tā niścayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ tatra ca grāhya abhāva anavagāhi tve pi yathā dāham prati maṇi ādoḥ viśiṣya eva pratibandhaka tā evam caitra tva ādinā viśiṣya śaktigrahāt bodha ādiḥ iti arthaḥ

analyzed: sāmānyam jalasya snehaḥ vahneḥ uṣṇa tā vāyoḥ vahana śīla tā ākāśasya sarvatas gatiḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ ca pṛthivī ādīnām viśeṣāḥ tad samūhaḥ dravyam tatra samūha mātram na dravyam iti bodhayitum uktam ayuta siddha iti etasya eva vivarāṇam nirantara tva rūpa iti

original: sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣāḥ śabdādayaḥ pañcarāgāḥ sattvādyatmakā eva tatsaṅghāta eva ghaṭādikaṃ natu tadvyatiriktamavayavirūpamastīti sāṃkhyasiddhāntaḥ| śataśaḥ chinnasyāpi paśoḥ rūparasagandhādivyatiriktasya kasya cidvastuno'nupalambhād guṇānāṃ samudāya eva dravyam|

original: tatra pratyekābhiprāyeṇa guṇavyavahāraḥ samudāyāmiprāyeṇa dravyavyavahāraḥ| lohakārpāsayorgurutvabhedastu samūhakṛta eva na dravyabhedakṛtaḥ| " tasya bhāvaḥ| ' iti sūtre bhāṣye'pi dravyaguṇayorbhedavyavahāraḥ samūhasamūhikṛta eveti bhāvaḥ| tatra samūhasamūhinorabhedāttad‌graho dravyam, vyākaraṇe tu guṇaśabdena dharmamātramucyate|

original: taduktam hiraṇā---
analyzed: tat uktam hiraṇā

original: saṃsargibhedakaṃ yadyatsavyāpāraṃ pratīyate|
analyzed: saṃsargi bhedakam yat yat sa vyāpāram pratīyate

original: guṇatvaṃ paratantratvāttasyaśāstre udāhṛtam||iti|
analyzed: guṇa tvam paratantra tvāt tasya śāstre udāhṛtam iti

original: saṃsargiṇa ādhārasya bhedakaṃ savyāpāramavacchedakarūpeṇa pratīyate tasya guṇatvam| loke hi paratantro guṇa ityucyate| tadāśrayo dravyamiti vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣā | iha tu sarvanāmaparāmarśayogyatvaṃ bhedyatvaṃ vetyādi dravyalakṣaṇam| ata eva dravyaṃ padārtha iti pakṣaḥ|ata evaca samānādhikaraṇaśabdasya samānadravyavacanatayā sarvarasa ityatra samāsaḥ|
analyzed: saṃsargiṇaḥ ādhārasya bhedakam sa vyāpāram avacchedaka rūpeṇa pratīyate tasya guṇa tvam loke hi paratantraḥ guṇaḥ iti ucyate tad āśrayaḥ dravyam iti vaiśeṣika paribhāṣā iha tu sarvanāma parāmarśa yogya tvam bhedya tvam vā ityādi dravya lakṣaṇam atas eva dravyam padārthaḥ iti pakṣaḥ atas eva ca samāna adhikaraṇa śabdasya samāna dravya vacana tayā sarva rasaḥ iti atra samāsaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ " vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci " ityatrāpi guṇādīnāṃ niṣedhāt śītoṣṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhamityatraikavadbhāvo na prāpnotīti cenna| tatra vacanasāmarthyātprasiddhadravyagrahaṇāt|
analyzed: nanu evam vipratiṣiddham ca anadhikaraṇa vāci iti atra api guṇa ādīnām niṣedhāt śīta uṣṇam sukha duḥkham iti atra eka vat bhāvaḥ na prāpnoti iti ced na tatra vacana sāmarthyāt prasiddha dravya grahaṇāt

original: " voto guṇavacanād " ityatra guṇopasarjanadravyagrahaṇājjātyādiviśiṣṭagrahaṇe prāpte " sattve niviśate " iti paribhāṣā āśritā|
analyzed: vā u taḥ guṇa vacanāt iti atra guṇa upasarjana dravya grahaṇāt jāti ādi viśiṣṭa grahaṇe prāpte sattve niviśate iti paribhāṣā āśritā

original: " guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhya " ityatra samāsādibhinnatvaṃ guṇatvamiti vārtikasamayaḥ | " tṛtīyātatkṛtārtha " ityatra khaṇḍādireva guṇaḥ|
analyzed: guṇavacana brāhmaṇa ādibhyaḥ iti atra samāsa ādi bhinna tvam guṇa tvam iti vārtika samayaḥ tṛtīyā tad kṛtārthaḥ iti atra khaṇḍa ādiḥ eva guṇaḥ

original: triguṇā rajjurityatra samavāyavacano guṇaśabdaḥ | guṇaśabdenāvayavānāmapi grahaṇāt| tatsamudāyo'pi dravyamiti vyavasthāpayati kañca samudāyaghaṭakatvādrūpādayo'pyavayavā ityabhipretyāha ayutasiddheti| etadabhipretyaivāha guṇapadeneti| bhāmatyāmiti|
analyzed: triguṇā rajjuḥ iti atra samavāya vacanaḥ guṇa śabdaḥ guṇa śabdena avayavānām api grahaṇāt tad samudāyaḥ api dravyam iti vyavasthāpayati samudāya ghaṭaka tvāt rūpa ādayaḥ api avayavāḥ iti abhipretya āha ayuta siddha iti etat abhipretya eva āha guṇa padena iti bhāmatyām iti

original: tatra hi ' niravayava' iti śārīrakabhāṣyapratīpādāya ' vrīhīṇāṃ khalu prokṣaṇena saṃskārākhyoṃ'śo yathā'numanyate naivaṃ brahmaṇi kaścidaṃśaḥ kriyādheyo'sti ' ityuktam|
analyzed: tatra hi niravayavaḥ iti śārīraka bhāṣya pratīpādāya vrīhīṇām khalu prokṣaṇena saṃskāra ākhyaḥ oṃśaḥ yathā anumanyate na evam brahmaṇi kaścid aṃśaḥ kriyā ādheyaḥ asti iti uktam

original: nanu guṇasamudāyasyaiva dravyatve svasyaivādhārādheyabhāvāsambhava ityata āha samudāyasamudāyinoriti | ata eva guṇāśraya iti| samūhasamūhinorbhedasyāpi svīkārādayamapi vyavahāra ityarthaḥ| nātirikteti| vṛkṣasamūha eva vanaṃ nātiriktamityarthaḥ| nanu avayavasamudāyasyaiva dvyatve tannāśaḥ kathamata āha vibhāga eva tannāśaka iti|
analyzed: nanu guṇa samudāyasya eva dravya tve svasya eva ādhāra ādheya bhāva asambhavaḥ iti atas āha samudāya samudāyinoḥ iti atas eva guṇa āśrayaḥ iti samūha samūhinoḥ bhedasya api svīkārāt ayam api vyavahāraḥ iti arthaḥ na atirikta iti vṛkṣa samūhaḥ eva vanam na atiriktam iti arthaḥ nanu avayava samudāyasya eva dvi atve tad nāśaḥ katham atas āha vibhāgaḥ eva tad nāśakaḥ iti

original: ata evāsamavāyikāraṇanāśātkāryanāśaḥ, na tu samavāyikāramanāśāt| paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvena dvyaṇukanāśānāpatteriti tārkikāḥ|
analyzed: atas eva asamavāyi kāraṇa nāśāt kārya nāśaḥ na tu samavāyi kāram anāśāt paramāṇūnām nitya tvena dvyaṇuka nāśa anāpatteḥ iti tārkikāḥ

original: nanu sampūrṇasyāpratyakṣe ghaṭādeḥ pratyakṣaṃ na syādata āha bhūyo vayaveti ||
analyzed: nanu sampūrṇasya apratyakṣe ghaṭa ādeḥ pratyakṣam na syāt atas āha bhūyas vayava iti
